items.e: The reason is as follows: It is known that the second constriction was established in Atik , that is, it raised the lower heh to the apertures of the eyes, in order to emanate the partzuf of Arikh Anpin (as stated above, section 13, third paragraph). Therefore, the Keter was divided into two halves, with the gulgalta , eyes, and apertures of the eyes remaining in Nukba of Atik , while the lower half of the Keter , which consists of the ears, nose, and mouth, was established as the partzuf of Arikh Anpin . In this state, the lower heh operates in the apertures of the eyes of Atik , and yod - heh - vav in the ears, nose, and mouth, which are Arikh Anpin . This is because the bottom heh of Havaya is missing in Arikh Anpin , and therefore there are only the first nine sefirot in Arikh Anpin , without Malkhut , and only the coronet of Yesod of Ze’er Anpin completes Arikh Anpin into ten sefirot , as is known. The Malkhut is concealed in the apertures of the eyes of Atik , and all the partzufim of Atzilut are imprinted from them. All [these] partzufim were divided into two halves: Gulgalta , eyes and the apertures of the eyes by themselves, and the ears, nose, and mouth by themselves. For [example], the Bina is divided into two partzufim , with the gulgalta , eyes and apertures of the eyes in [ Bina ] established as Abba and Imma Ila'in , and the ears, nose, and mouth in [ Bina ] as Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna .

Thus, the lower heh [of the level of Bina ] is in the apertures of the eyes of Abba and Imma Ila'in , and yod - heh - vav , without the lower heh , are in Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . The [ yod-heh-vav ] lack the Malkhut because their Malkhut remained in the apertures of the eyes of Abba and Imma (father and mother), in the manner stated above with regard to Atik and Arikh Anpin . Similarly, in Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , the gulgalta and eyes were established as the large Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , and the ears, nose, and mouth as the small Ze’er Anpin and Nukba . The Malkhut remained in the apertures of the eyes of the large Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , and the small Ze’er Anpin and Nukba have only the first nine [ sefirot ], without Malkhut . Only the coronet of Yesod completes [their sefirot by serving] as their Malkhut , in the manner stated above regarding Atik and Arikh Anpin . Thus, just as the Keter was divided into two halves – the first three and the lower seven – so too was Bina divided, and also Ze’er Anpin and Nukba : The lower heh remained in the first three of each, while in the lower seven there are only yod - heh - vav , without the lower heh , and only the coronet of Yesod of Malkhut completes the [total count of the sefirot ] instead of Malkhut .

Therefore, the upper half of each [of these] levels remains of the aspect of "unknown." This is like the partzuf of Atik , in which the lower heh does not return and descend from the apertures of the eyes even in the phase of maturity. Although in the phase of maturity the [ partzufim ] bring back to themselves the vessels of ears, nose, and mouth that they lacked, they still do not draw forth the first three of the lights. This is on account of the lower heh that is concealed in them, upon which the first constriction occurred, so as not to receive [the light of] Ḥokhma . Consequently, the first three [of the level] always remain in the light of giving, in the mystical meaning of pure air. Instead, only the lower half of each level draws forth the first three of lights in the phase of maturity, in the mystical meaning of the yod emerging from their air, and this [lower aspect] returns to be the light of Ḥokhma and the first three.

As a result, it is considered that the partzufim of the first three [ sefirot ] that are drawn in [each of] the five partzufim of Atzilut are regarded as only the six extremities of Ḥokhma and remain lacking in the first three of Ḥokhma . This is because the first three of each partzuf do not receive Ḥokhma , but rather [only] the six extremities of each partzuf [receive Ḥokhma ]. For this reason, there is only the [level of six extremities of Ḥokhma in the brains [of these levels].

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] thus says: **“The six higher days give to the Torah and not more.”** The meaning is as stated, that the Ze’er Anpin only receives from the supernal brains of the six days, which are the brains of six extremities. But **“the others are concealed”** – the first three of the brains are hidden, since they are hidden even in the partzufim that are higher than [ Ze'er Anpin ], as only the aspect of the six extremities of the higher partzufim have brains.

**42. “However, we saw etc.” However, we saw with regard to the secrets of Bereshit that he said as follows: That hidden, holy one engraved [ galifei ] a carving in the intestines,** which is the mystical meaning of Bina , **of one hidden one,** the mystical meaning of the Nukba of Atik , **that is dotted with the embedded point**, the mystical meaning of the point of the Malkhut of the first constriction, which ascended to Bina and ejected the ears, nose, and mouth of Arikh Anpin out of his head**. That carving**, which was engraved in Bina , **was engraved and concealed in** [ Bina ]**, like one who hides everything behind a single key, and the whole of that one key is hidden in a single palace. And although everything is hidden in that palace, the essence of everything is in that key,** because **it is that key which closes and opens.**

Explanation: ** Galifei ** refers to the engraving [that led to] the lack of ears, nose, and mouth of the vessels. The **“holy, hidden one”** is Arikh Anpin , who is called “the holy sealed Ḥokhma ”; **“of one hidden one**” **–** the Nukba of Atik ; **“in his intestines, of one hidden one”** – meaning in the interior of Nukba of Atik . **“Dotted”** is referring to the establishment of the partition for the mystical meaning of a fusion through collision. **“With the imbedded point”** means with a dot that is embedded in a circle. This is the Malkhut of the first constriction, which is called the middle point, on which the first constriction was performed. This is in contrast to the partition that is established with the coronet of Yesod , which is the case for the six extremities of all the partzufim , as stated just earlier. This partition of the coronet of Yesod is called “the point of the settlement,” rather than “the middle point.”

The meaning is that Arikh Anpin is engraved and becomes lacking in its first three [ sefirot ] as a result of the internal makeup of [the level] above. [This level above is[ Nukba of Atik , which is established with the lower heh in the apertures of its eyes, as stated above.

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] then states: **“That carving was engraved and concealed in her, like one who hides everything behind a single key.”** This **“key”** refers to the aspect of Malkhut that is the coronet of Yesod , which is established in every [level of] six extremities of the partzufim of Atzilut , as stated in the previous section. As explained there, in the partzufim of the six extremities the yod emerges from their avir [air] and they become or [light]. This means that the partition descends from the apertures of the eyes [of those partzufim of the six extremities] to the mouth, and this returns the ears, nose, and mouth back to the level. Subsequently, once these [aspects of the six extremities] have the ears, nose, and mouth of the vessels, they also acquire the first three of lights. Accordingly, the partition in the apertures of the eyes is called a “key,” because [the partition] closes the partzuf from the illumination of the first three while [the partition] is in the apertures of the eyes, before reopening [the partzuf ] to the lights of the first three when [the partition] descends back to its place, to the mouth. For this reason, it is also called “the opening of the eyes” (as stated in section 7, and in the Sulam there, second paragraph).

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] thus says: **“And concealed in her, like one who hides everything behind a single key.”** In other words, although Atik itself was engraved with the lower heh , as stated above, nevertheless, that carving which was engraved in Arikh Anpin as a result of [its mirroring] of Atik is dissimilar to the carving of Atik itself, since Arikh Anpin was carved with a “key,” the coronet of Yesod , for [ Arikh Anpin ] lacked the Malkhut , as stated. It follows that only the coronet of Yesod operates in the apertures of the eyes of Arikh Anpin , not the lower heh . Therefore, the air of Arikh Anpin is known, because it is established with that key, whereas the air of Atik is unknown, since the Malkhut of the middle point is within [ Atik ], and it does not draw the first three [lights] through [ Atik ], as stated. [As an aside, ] you should not find problematic the statement here that Arikh Anpin possesses gulgalta and eyes, even though we said above that [ Arikh Anpin ] has only ears, nose, and mouth, which are the lower half of the Keter . The reason is that with respect to Atik , Arikh Anpin has only ears, nose, and mouth, but with respect to itself, Arikh Anpin [possesses] the gulgalta and eyes and lacks ears, nose, and mouth, as explained (in my book, Introduction to the Wisdom of the Kabbalah , page 25, s.v., Ve-al zeh ).

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] next states: **“And the whole of that one key is hidden in a single palace.”** Arikh Anpin emanated Abba and Imma Ila'in and also engraved Abba and Imma Ila'in without the first three of lights and [without] the ears, nose, and mouth of the vessels. [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] are the **“palace”** in which all the lights of the first three [ sefirot ] were hidden – the first three [ sefirot of the light] of neshama , the first three [ sefirot of the light] of ḥaya , as well as the first three [ sefirot of the light] of yeḥida . When [Rabbi Ḥiyya] states **“the whole** [of that one key] **is hidden,”** he means that Arikh Anpin also drew the lower heh of Atik into this palace, as well as the aspect of [ Arikh Anpin ] itself, the “key.”

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] continues: **“And although everything is hidden in that palace, the essence of everything is in that key.”** The “palace” is Bina , which is a palace for Ḥokhma . In [ Bina ] are [a set of] first three [ sefirot ] and six extremities. The lower heh rules over [this aspect of] the first three [ sefirot of Bina ], while the **“key,”** the coronet of Yesod , rules over [the aspect of] the six extremities [of Bina ]. This is the meaning of the statement: **“And although everything is hidden in that palace,”** i.e., even the lower heh from Atik , nevertheless, **“the essence of everything is in that key,”** in the coronet of Yesod alone. The reason [the essence is only in the six extremities] is that it is only in the six extremities of Bina , called Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , that the concealment is discerned, [the concealment] meaning [there is a level of] six extremities without a head of the first three [ sefirot ]. This [concealment] is not the case for the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina , which are Abba and Imma (father and mother), in which, while the lower heh is in the apertures of the eyes, the [aspect of the] first three [ sefirot ] is not lacking at all. This is because the [the light of giving] of Abba and Imma are considered like the Ḥokhma and the first three [for the level of Bina ] (as stated above, in Marot HaSulam , section 2, s.v. Ve-hu ).

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] concludes: **“It is that key which closes and opens.”** The closing and opening are performed by means of the lower heh in the apertures of the eyes, for when [ Malkhut ] ascends to the apertures of the eyes, it closes off the brains of the first three, since [as a result of the ascension of Malkhut ] the partzuf is left lacking the ears, nose, and mouth of the vessels, as well as the first three of the lights. When [ Malkhut ] descends from the apertures of the eyes back to the mouth, it opens [the conduit] for the brains of the first three [ sefirot ] so that they will illuminate in the partzuf . [The descent of Malkhut ] returns the ears, nose, and mouth of the vessels and the first three of the lights back to the partzuf . This illustrates that it is only the lower heh itself that closes and opens. Nevertheless, since the opening of the brains is not in the first three, but only in the lower seven, where the lower heh does not rule, but rather the coronet of Yesod , which is called the **“key,”** and the first three of each level – where the lower heh rules – always remain in the state of air that is unknown (as stated), the closing and opening are therefore attributed to the “key,” not to the lower heh .

**43. “In that palace, there are etc.” In that palace, there are many hidden treasures, stacked atop each other. In that palace, there are gates – fifty of them – that are designed to seal off**, i.e., they are fashioned so as to block the lights**. They were carved in four directions, and were forty-nine** gates**, since one gate has no side** and **it is unknown whether it is above or below. For this reason that gate remains sealed.**

Explanation: There are many kinds of [ sefirot ] of the “first three” – the first three of [the level of light of] neshama , the first three of ḥaya , and the first three of yeḥida . Each of these three kinds of “first three” contains innumerable details. This is the meaning of: **“Many hidden treasures in that palace, stacked atop each other.”** When the lower heh resides in the apertures of the eyes, all these levels are concealed and unknown.

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] then states [that there are] **“gates – fifty of them – that are designed to seal off.”** These “gates” are receptacles for lights, which can be in one of two states: a) When they are still **“sealed off,”** i.e., the gates are closed and sealed and do not receive anything; b) When the gates are opened and receive lights from the [level] above. He thus says: **“Gates – fifty of them – that are designed to seal off,”** as when the palace gates are in the closed state, they number fifty. However, when it comes to opening the gates, they are only forty-nine, as will be explained below. The concept of the number fifty is because the ten sefirot are essentially only five sefirot : Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , Tiferet , and Malkhut , but Tiferet incorporates six extremities so [together] they are ten. Consequently, when each of the five sefirot incorporates ten [ sefirot ], they are fifty.

**“They were carved in four directions, and they became forty-nine.”** As explained above, the closing and opening are not carried out in [the context of] the [full] lower heh , but only in the “key,” which is the coronet [of Yesod ]. Thus, the aspect of "carving, " [meaning] the carvings [of vessels] suitable for receiving [the lights], was not formed in all five sefirot : Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , Tiferet , and Malkhut , but only in the four sefirot : Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , and Tiferet , not in Malkhut , and four times ten is forty. However, Malkhut also incorporates ten sefirot , which are Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , Tiferet , and Malkhut , and thus [ Malkhut ] can also receive from the “key” to its first nine [ sefirot ], i.e., until the coronet of Yesod [of Malkhut ]. Therefore, forty-nine sefirot are carved out: Forty from the four sefirot : Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , and Tiferet , each of which is comprised of ten, and the first nine sefirot from the Malkhut that incorporates ten. The result is that only the Malkhut of Malkhut is missing.

**“One gate has no side; it is unknown whether it is above or below. For this reason, that gate remains sealed.”** This is the Malkhut of Malkhut , which is the fiftieth gate, the lower heh itself that descends from the eyes to the mouth at the time of maturity, as stated above. It was explained earlier that although the lower heh descends from the apertures of the eyes of Abba and Imma Ila'in to the mouth, and the [vessels of] ears, nose, and mouth [of Abba and Imma Ila'in ] (together with Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna that enclothe [those vessels]) combine with the level of Abba and Imma into a single partzuf (as then the first three of the light are drawn into them) – nevertheless, the Abba and Imma Ila'in do not receive anything from the lights of the first three and they remain in a state of pure air alone, and it is as though the lower heh did not descend at all from the apertures of their eyes. It therefore follows that with respect to the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina , which are Abba and Imma Ila'in , it is not discernible whether the lower heh is still positioned at the apertures of their eyes above, since they remain only [containing] the light of giving as before, or whether the lower heh descended from the apertures of the eyes to the place of the mouth. [This latter option is implied since] the vessels of ears, nose and mouth of [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] ascended [back to their place] along with Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna and they transmit the brains of the first three of lights to Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . [This illustrates that] it is necessarily the case that the lower heh descended to the mouth. [Thus it is] the case that if we were to look from the perspective of Abba and Imma , it would seem to us that the lower heh is [still] above, in the apertures of the eyes, whereas if we were to look from the perspective of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , we would see it below, in the mouth.

This is the meaning of the statement: **“One gate has no side,”** i.e., the Malkhut of Malkhut , which is the essence of the lower heh ; **“it is unknown whether it is above or below,”** since with respect to Abba and Imma , [the heh ] is above, whereas in relation to Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna it is below. **“For this reason, that gate remains sealed.”** The consequence is that this Malkhut of Malkhut is not opened at all, and it remains as sealed as during the phase of immaturity, that is, before the descent [of the heh ] to the mouth. The opening of the gates transpires only in Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , where the lower heh is lacking and the coronet of Yesod operates in its stead. However, in the Abba and Imma , where the lower heh [itself] does operate, they remain sealed from the first three, as before.

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] thus states: **“For this reason, that gate remains sealed.”** You must comprehend that although the fiftieth gate is the Malkhut of Malkhut , as stated, that is the case only with respect to the vessels. However, with respect to the lights, it is considered the first three of the brains, as on account [of the Malkhut of Malkhut ], Abba and Imma Ila'in remained in [the state of] the light of giving without the first three [of the brains of Ḥokhma ], and the same applies to all of the higher levels (as stated in section 41 above, third paragraph). Thus, the sealing of the fiftieth gate causes the lack of the first three of the brains in all the levels, such that they contain only [the level] of the brains of the six extremities. You can thereby understand the statement of the Sages ( Nedarim 38a) that all fifty gates of Bina were granted to Moses, apart from one. This is the mystical meaning of the lack of the first three [ sefirot ] of the brains, as stated. These first three of the brains will illuminate in the levels only at the completion of the rectification.

**44. “Within those gates etc.” Within those gates there is one lock, and one narrow place through which to insert that key. It is inscribed** and recognizable **only by the inscription of the key,** [meaning] that **it**, that narrow space, **is known through that key alone. And it is written with regard to this secret: Bereshit bara Elohim ** (“In the beginning [God] created,” [Genesis 1:1])**. Bereshit is the key in which everything is hidden, and it is that which closes and opens. Six gates are incorporated in that key, which closes and opens. When it closes those gates and incorporates them within itself, then it is certainly written: Bereshit , a revealed word within a sealed word, and in all places Bara is a sealed word,** which indicates that the key **closes and does not open.**

Explanation: The lower heh in the apertures of the eyes is called a “lock,” since it locks the lights of the first three [ sefirot ] so that they cannot illuminate in the partzuf , as long as [the lower heh ] is positioned above, in the apertures of the eyes. He states: **“Within those gates, there is one lock, and within that lock there is one narrow place,”** i.e., the Yesod in the lower heh , which is the forty-ninth gate of the vessels, as the lower heh itself is Malkhut of Malkhut , the fiftieth gate, whereas Yesod of Malkhut is the forty-ninth gate, **“through which to insert that key.”** The “key” enters the Yesod of the lower heh , and it is the coronet of Yesod of the brains that brings down the lower heh from the apertures of the eyes to the mouth, and the partzuf is opened to the lights of the first three. This is why the coronet of Yesod is called a “key.”

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] then states: **“It is inscribed only by the inscription of the key; it is known through that key alone.”** The “key” is the coronet of Yesod of the brains, and it enters its corresponding aspect in the lower heh , which is Yesod of Malkhut , as stated. The “lock,” which is the lower heh , is inscribed to hide and lock the first three **“only by the inscription of the key,”** which rules over the lower seven [ sefirot ] of Bina ( Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ). However, [the key does not enter the lower heh ] itself, the lower heh that rules over the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina , which are the Abba and Imma Ila'in , which are always regarded as a complete first three [ sefirot ]. Likewise, the “lock” is inscribed to open only by [the key of] Yesod of the brains.

The result is that **“it is known through that key alone.”** This “knowledge” means the drawing forth of brains, and he is saying that the brains were drawn forth only in the aspect of the “key,” i.e., in the lower seven [ sefirot ] of Bina . It is here that the “key” operates, the coronet of Yesod . However, in the place of Abba and Imma Ila'in , which are the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina , where the “key” does not operate, but only the lower heh itself, they remain in a state of "unknown." This fully clarifies how despite the fact that with respect to the lower heh itself, **“it is unknown whether it is above or below,”** as stated above [section 43], nevertheless it is still enough to be known for the sake of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , since through [the "key"] there is an opening of the brains of the first three. In Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , there are only yod - heh - vav without Malkhut , and the coronet of Yesod serves as a partition instead of the Malkhut . The brains which bring down the lower heh from the apertures of the eyes to the mouth, also serve only in the partition of the coronet of Yesod , because [there is no need for these brains in the partition of the lower heh ], as there was no closing and deficiency of the first three [ sefirot ] at all in the lower heh that would need to be opened. This [lack of deficiency in the first three is] because [the lower heh ] operates in Abba and Imma (father and mother), who always [possess] the [aspect of the] first three, as stated.

Since the entire concealment and closing occurred only in the aspect of the coronet of Yesod , which operates in Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , the result is that only the coronet of Yesod of the brains is the “key” to bring down the lower heh from the eyes to the mouth, i.e., only in the delicate vessels, which are fashioned with the force of the partition of the coronet of Yesod , like [those brains]. This is why he concludes that **“it is known through that key alone,”** meaning, the brains reach only the vessels of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna that emerge from the aspect of the “key,” [which is] the coronet of Yesod . [The brains do not reach] Abba and Imma , which are from the aspect of the lower heh , Malkhut of Malkhut , the essence of the lock.

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] continues: **“ Bereshit is the key** etc.” That is, the word Bereshit , which is Ḥokhma , incorporates within itself only the aforementioned “key,” which is merely the coronet of Yesod , the forty-ninth gate of the [the aspect of] vessels. It does not incorporate the fiftieth gate of the vessels, which is Malkhut of Malkhut . He thus states: **“ Bereshit is the key in which everything is hidden,”** i.e., everything is blocked with [the key] in the phase of immaturity. **“And it is that which closes and opens,”** as it closes all the brains in the phase of immaturity, while the lower heh is in the eyes, and opens [the brains] in the phase of maturity, to bring down the lower heh from the apertures of the eyes to the mouth. The ramification of this is that this is why the opening of Ḥokhma (which is alluded to in the word Bereshit ) is only for the six extremities of the levels, which are of the aspect of the vessels **“of that key”** (as stated in section 41, above, third paragraph; see there). However, the brains of Bereshit do not illuminate for the first three of the partzufim , since their vessels are not from the aspect of the “key” but rather from the aspect of the lower heh , as stated.

Accordingly, [Rabbi Ḥiyya] states: **“Six gates are incorporated by that key, which closes and opens,”** as the first three [ sefirot ] of the brains are lacking from it, and it opens only the lower seven [ sefirot ] of the brains, such that each of the lower seven [ sefirot ] only contains six extremities, and they are seven partzufim of six extremities. Thus, the “key,” i.e., the seventh sefira , the coronet of Yesod , contains within it only six gates. This is the meaning of the statement: **“Six gates are incorporated in that key, which closes and opens,”** indicating that it draws only [the aspect of] six extremities of brains.

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] then states: **“ Bereshit , a revealed word within a sealed word, and in all places Bara is a sealed word.”** In other words, Bereshit represents Ḥokhma , which is **“a revealed word,”** but when it states Bereshit bara , this means that the Ḥokhma is hidden and sealed. He says [that] **“ Bereshit ** [is] **a revealed word within a sealed word”** because it is followed by the word ** bara , “and in all places Bara is a sealed word.”** Thus, Bereshit bara means that the Ḥokhma is sealed. The implication of **“closes and does not open,”** is that the Ḥokhma is closed and not yet opened.

**45. “Rabbi Yosei said etc.” Rabbi Yosei said: That is certainly the case. And I heard from the Holy Luminary**, Rabbi Shimon, **that he said this, that bara (created) is a sealed word,** which shows that the key **closes and does not open. While** the key **closes with the word bara , there was no world and it did not exist, and emptiness covered everything. When that emptiness ruled, there was no world and it did not exist.**

**46. “When did that key etc.” When did that key open the gates, and was made ready for use and to birth offspring?** It was **upon the arrival of Abraham,** who is the mystical meaning of Ḥesed , **as it is stated: “These are the generations of the heaven and of the earth when they were created [ behibare’am ]”** (Genesis 2:4)**, and we learned:** Do not read behibare’am , but ** be-Avraham ** [“with Abraham”]**.** Then, **everything that was hidden in the word bara ,** as stated, **the letters**, which are the vessels, **returned** and opened **to listen. The pillar that births offspring emerged, the organ** [ evar ] **of the holy foundation upon which the world stands**, as bara has the same letters as evar **.**

Explanation: [Rabbi Yosei] asks: **“When did that key open the gates, and was made ready for use and to birth offspring?”** There are three aspects to this question: 1) **“Open the gates” –** referring to the descent of the lower heh from the apertures of the eyes to the mouth, at which point the forty-nine gates of the brains of Ḥokhma were opened, as stated above. 2) **“And was made ready for use” –** this refers to the enclothing of the [light of the brains of] Ḥokhma in the light of giving, since before the Ḥokhma is enclothed in the light of giving, the ears, nose, and mouth cannot receive the brains of Ḥokhma , even though they have already combined with the gulgalta and eyes into a single level (as stated in section 16, above). Without the enclothing of the light of giving, ** Mi ** cannot illuminate in ** eleh **, and alef - lamed-heh [ eleh ] remains sealed in the name; see there. Thus, [in such a state, ] the brains are not yet fit for use in the lower level. 3) **“And to birth offspring”** – meaning the birthing of souls, because after the Ze’er Anpin receives these brains in their complete state it pairs with the Nukba and births the souls of the righteous.

[Rabbi Yosei] answers: **“Upon the arrival of Abraham,** etc. **everything that was hidden in the word bara , the letters returned to listen.”** Abraham is the mystical meaning of Ḥesed of Ze’er Anpin of maturity, when the Ḥesed becomes Ḥokhma , as stated in the Zohar ( Shemot , 249). Before Abraham arrived, everything was sealed in the word ** bara **, and emptiness ruled over the world, [the "world" referring to] Ze’er Anpin and Nukba . At that stage, Ze’er Anpin and Nukba did not have either [the light of giving] or Ḥokhma . But **“upon the arrival of Abraham,”** who is the light of Ḥesed that is bestowed upon Ze’er Anpin , the gates opened with the shefa of Ḥokhma . The lower heh descended from the eyes to the mouth, and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna joined with Abba and Imma Ila'in into a single level, and the first three [ sefirot ] of the lights, which are the light of Ḥokhma , were drawn to Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . Since Ze’er Anpin already had the light of giving from the aspect of **Abraham**, the lights of Ḥokhma were enclothed in the light of giving, and then **the letters alef - lamed-heh ** [ eleh ] **joined with mem-yod ** [ Mi ] **and the name Elohim was complete**, and the brains were enclothed in Ze’er Anpin .

This is the meaning of the statement: **“Upon the arrival of Abraham,** etc. **the letters returned to listen.”** The brains of Ḥokhma were drawn into the light of giving and were enclothed in Ze’er Anpin . **“The pillar that births offspring emerged” –** since then the lower heh descended from the apertures of the eyes of Ze’er Anpin to the mouth [of Ze'er Anpin ], and [ Ze'er Anpin ] too attained [the aspects of] Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Nukba , which [ Ze'er Anpin ] had lacked. They are called, with respect to [ Ze'er Anpin ], “new Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod ,” with Yesod of [the phase of] maturity called **“the organ of the holy foundation upon which the world stands.”** It is through this organ that [ Ze'er Anpin ] transmits to the Nukba , which is called “the lower world,” and [through this Ze'er Anpin ] gives birth to the souls of the righteous. This is [what occurs] in general terms. However, the detailed [description of the] order of the drawing forth of the brains will be explained afterward.

**47. “When this evar etc.” When this evar ** [organ] **was inscribed with the word bara , then the supernal Hidden One inscribed another inscription in His name and for His honor. This is Mi , and He created eleh . Also, the holy, blessed name, which is Ma , was inscribed and brought out evar from bara . It is inscribed in eleh on one side and in evar on the other side. The hidden holy one, eleh , exists,** and ** evar exists. When one is completed, the other is** [also] **completed. He engraved** the letter ** heh for this evar and engraved** the letter ** yod for this eleh .**

Explanation: [Rabbi Yosei] now explains in detail the concept of the brains of Ze’er Anpin , which he had earlier depicted in general terms. He states that **“when this evar was inscribed in the word bara , [then] the supernal Hidden One inscribed another inscription,”** which is ** Mi **. The meaning is that ** evar ** is the Yesod and coronet [of Yesod ] while ** bara ** indicates the blocking of the first three [ sefirot ] due to the force of the ascent of the lower heh to the aperture of the eyes, as stated above. [Rabbi Yosei] says that this coronet of the **“ evar was inscribed”** with the lower heh that is in the aperture of the eyes. This is as Rabbi Ḥiyya said above [section 44], **that this “lock,”** which is the lower heh , **is inscribed by the inscription of the “key,”** which is the coronet of Yesod ; see there. This **supernal hidden one,** which is Abba and Imma Ila'in , which are inscribed with the lower heh , now made **“another inscription”** in this **“lock”** of theirs, i.e., the inscription of **the “key,”** which is the coronet of this ** evar **. It is then called **“ Mi , which is ready for a question,”** that is, fit to receive feminine waters and to bring down the lower heh from the eyes, and to raise up the letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** [ eleh ], which are the ears, nose, and mouth, with which the first three of lights are drawn. This is not the case before the lower heh is inscribed in the inscription of ** evar ** – there was no possibility of drawing forth the first three [ sefirot ], since the lower heh itself is the mystical meaning of the fiftieth gate, which is not opened [to allow] the first three, as stated. Therefore, before there is an inscribing in this **key of evar ,** [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] are not called Mi , as it is not ready for a question.

[Rabbi Yosei] thus states: **“When this evar was inscribed in the word bara ”** – when the lower heh in the word ** bara ** received the inscription of ** evar **, which is **the “key,” “then the supernal Hidden One inscribed another inscription in His name and for His honor; this is Mi .”** Then Abba and Imma (father and mother) inscribed **the “key,”** in the lower heh that is in the aperture of their eyes, so that it should be fit to be called **“ Mi , who is ready for a question,”** and to draw forth the brains of the first three [ sefirot ], as stated. The brains are drawn only **by the inscription of this key.**

This is the meaning of the statement” **“And He created eleh .”** That is, after the lock in the word ** bara ** was inscribed with **the inscription of the key**, which is the ** evar **, and was fashioned in the mystical meaning of ** Mi **, as stated, then **“ Mi has created [ bara ] these.”** Meaning, the lower heh descended from the aperture of the eyes to the mouth, and [this] raised the ears, nose, and mouth, which are the letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** [ eleh ], to the head, and the first three [ sefirot ] were drawn, as stated. When [the Zohar ] states that **“He created eleh ,”** it is a language of sealing because these do not yet possess the light of giving, which means that these letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** that ascended are still **sealed in the name** (as stated in section 14 above, sixth paragraph), and they cannot reveal themselves without the [enclothing of] the garment of the light of giving.

[Rabbi Yosei] continues: **“Also, the holy, blessed name, which is Ma , was inscribed and it brought out evar from bara .”** The Malkhut [which is the lower heh ] that descended from the eyes to the mouth is called ** Ma **, for the lower world is called ** Ma ** (as stated in section 8, above; see there). This partition that was previously in the aperture of the eyes now descends to the mouth and a fusion through collision transpired upon [this partition] and brought forth a height of the [light of giving], which is the light of blessing (as stated in section 14, seventh paragraph). This [process] extracted the sealed aspect of the word ** bara ** and formed it into ** evar **, which is the Yesod that bestows [the light of giving] ( ḥassadim ). He therefore states that **“also, the holy, blessed name, which is Ma , was inscribed and it brought out ever from bara .”** The light of giving was still lacking for the letters ** alef - lamed-heh **, in which they could be enclothed, and consequently ** alef - lamed-heh ** were still **sealed in the name**. Through the light of blessing of ** Ma ,** the sealed aspect of ** bara ** was opened and it became an ** evar ** [organ] that transmits.

[Rabbi Yosei] continues: **“It is inscribed in eleh on one side and in evar on the other side.”** That is, two aspects can now be discerned in [these letters], one opposite the other. For ** eleh **, which are the ears, nose, and mouth, with the brains of Ḥokhma , which still lack the light of giving, are on one side, and ** evar **, which is the Yesod that received the height of the light of giving from the ** Ma **, stands opposite it on the other side, without Ḥokhma . This is the meaning of his statement: **“The hidden holy one, eleh , exists,** and ** evar exists.”** The ** eleh ** that attained the brains of Ḥokhma , which is called **“holy,”** exists in a sealed state in the partzuf on this side, while opposite it stands ** evar **, with a height of the [light of giving] in the partzuf . He thus says: **“When one is completed, the other is completed,”** since both of them emerged as a result of the descent of the lower heh from the aperture of the eyes to the mouth. The ** evar ** emerged through the power of the ** Ma ** in the mouth, and similarly the ** eleh **, which are the ears, nose, and mouth, rose upwards through the power of the arrival of the Malkhut to below them, to the mouth. As a result, **“when one is completed, the other is completed,”** since they arrive simultaneously.

**“He engraved** the letter ** heh for this evar , and engraved** the letter ** yod for this eleh .”** Heh refers to the partition that brings forth only the height of the [light of giving] without Ḥokhma – since [the heh ] is an embodiment of Malkhut that is unfit to receive Ḥokhma , but only the light of giving – while yod refers to the partition of the male, which is fit to receive Ḥokhma . This is the meaning of: **“He engraved heh for this evar ,”** i.e., with the partition ** Ma ** that draws forth only the light of giving, without Ḥokhma ; **“and engraved yod for this eleh ,”** that is, with the partition of the male, which draws forth Ḥokhma , but not the [light of giving].

**48. “When the letters awakened to complete etc.”** [Rabbi Yosei] elaborates: **When the letters**, alef-bet-resh [ evar ] and heh , and the letters alef - lamed-heh [ eleh ] and yod , **awakened to be completed on this side and the other side, then** the letter **final mem emerged. One took** the final mem **to this side,** i.e., to the side of the letters alef - lamed-heh-yod , **and** the other **one took** the final mem **to that side,** to the side of the letters alef-bet-resh-heh , **and the holy name was completed and** the combination **formed Elohim ** [ alef- lamed-heh-yod- final mem ]**, and the name Abraham** [ alef-bet-resh-heh- final mem ] **was also** completed**.** This is the meaning of the earlier statement: **“When one is completed, the other is completed.” Some say that the Holy One, blessed be He, took** the letters ** mem-yod ** [ Mi ] **and inserted them in** the letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** [ eleh ], **and** the combination **formed Elohim , and the Holy One, blessed be He, took** the letters ** mem-heh ** [ Ma ] **and inserted them in** the letters ** alef-bet-resh ** [ evar ], **and** the combination **formed Abraham. The word Mi alludes to the fifty gates of Bina ** [Understanding]**, and** the word ** Mi contains** the letter ** yod ,** which is **the first letter of the holy name. The word Ma alludes to the number of the holy name,** since Havaya , when it is “filled” and has the letters alef [i.e., each of its letters is spelled out, with each heh ending with an alef , and the vav has an alef in the middle], has the numerical value of 45 [ ma ]. **And** the word Ma **contains the second letter of the holy name Havaya **, which is the letter heh **. This is as it is stated: “Happy is the people that is in such a state;** [happy is the people] whose God is Havaya ” (Psalms 144:15), and it is stated: **“He hangs the earth over nothing** [ beli ma ]**”** (Job 26:7), which alludes to the numerical value of Havaya , when it is “filled” and has the letters alef , i.e., 45**. Two worlds then exist; the World-to-Come with yod , and this world with heh (that is, He created the World-to-Come with Mi , and this world with Ma , and this alludes to above and below). Then He made offspring, and the name emerged complete, which was not the case previously. This is the meaning of the verse: “These are the generations of the heaven and of the earth when they were created [ behibare’am ]”** (Genesis 2:4), which has the letters of BeAbraham [ bet-alef-bet-resh-heh- final mem , meaning "with Abraham"]**. All** the offspring **were hanging** in an imperfect state **until the name of Abraham was created. When this name of Abraham was completed, the holy name was completed. This is the meaning of the verse: “On the day that Havaya , God, made earth and heaven”** (Genesis 2:4). [The phrase] “on the day He made” means on the day they were completed, through the name Abraham, and at this stage the name Havaya appears, as this name of Havaya had not previously been mentioned in the Torah.

Explanation: These two heights, the light of Ḥokhma in ** eleh **, and the light of giving in ** Ma **, were awakened to complete each other, that is, to be enclothed in one another. Once the Ḥokhma is enclothed in the light of giving, **“he then brought out** the letter **final mem ,”** i.e., the Malkhut that receives from these two levels together.

[Rabbi Yosei] continues: **“One was taken to this side, and one to that side; the holy name was completed and formed Elohim , and the name Abraham was also** completed**.”** The meaning is as was explained before, **“He engraved** the letter ** yod for this eleh ,”** and therefore there are now four letters – ** alef - lamed-heh-yod ** – and likewise **“He engraved** the letter ** heh for this evar ,”** such that there are now four letters there – ** alef-bet-resh-heh **. The result is as follows: First, the letters completed one another, i.e., the two levels, [the light of] Ḥokhma and the light of giving, were enclothed in one another, and this brought out the **final mem **, which is the Malkhut that receives from them all, as stated. Subsequently, **one** [name] **took** that final mem **to its side, and** the other **one took** the final mem **to its side**. **“One took** the final mem **to its side,”** as the letters alef - lamed-heh-yod took the **final mem **, [and] **the holy name was completed and** the combination **formed Elohim .** Similarly, the letters ** alef-bet-resh-heh ** took the **final mem and the name Abraham was also** completed.
**“Some say that the Holy One, blessed be He, took** the letters ** mem-yod ** [ Mi ].” From here until the words “alludes to above and below,” in parenthesis, is not part of the Zohar .

**“When this name of Abraham was completed, the holy name was completed...**” since these [two names] are two heights, [one] of [the light of] Ḥokhma and [one of] the light of giving which need each other, as stated. Therefore, **the holy name** was not completed before **the name of Abraham** was completed.

**49. “Rabbi Ḥiyya prostrated etc.” Rabbi Ḥiyya prostrated himself on the ground, kissed the dust, and wept, declaring: “Dust, dust! How stubborn you are! How impudent! For everything that the eye covets will wither in you; all the pillars of light in the world, you will consume and grind. How impudent you are – the holy luminary that was illuminating the world, the great ruler, the one appointed** over the world**, whose merit sustains the world, is withering in you: Rabbi Shimon, the light of the luminary, the light of the worlds, you wither in the dust, and** [yet] **you exist and lead the world.” He was silent for a moment and** [then] **said: “Dust, dust, do not be proud, for the pillars of the world will not be handed over to you, since Rabbi Shimon is not withering in you.”**

We must thoroughly understand the meaning of this prostration on the part of Rabbi Ḥiyya. The meaning is that you will find in the section dealing with Rabbi Ḥiyya and Rabbi Yosei [section 41] that their main focus as they were walking along the way together was **on that sealed gate,** which is Malkhut of Malkhut . [This Malkhut ] receives nothing from all those higher brains [that manifest] in the six thousand years before the completion of the rectification, as is comprehensively explained in the section of Rabbi Ḥiyya. Rabbi Yosei replied to him in the name of Rabbi Shimon that **“this is certainly the case”** that this gate remains sealed, and the wholeness [that is achieved with these higher brains] is only in the “key,” as stated. This is what distressed them so greatly, until Rabbi Ḥiyya arrived at a great awakening and **“prostrated himself on the ground, kissed the dust, and wept, declaring: “Dust, dust! How stubborn you are** etc.**”**

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] then says: **“For everything that the eye covets will wither in you.”** On account of the sin of the first man, all the souls, which encompass all the souls in the world, were detached from him and were taken captive to the kelippot . Through his repentance, Adam the first [man] rectified only his own individual [soul], and even that not completely. After him, the souls are distilled each generation through repentance and good deeds until the completion of the rectification. Thus, all those lofty souls of [the level of] yeḥida and [of the level of] the first three of ḥaya depend upon [the process of] distilling and fusion through collision, upon the [sealed level of] Malkhut of Malkhut , which is the sealed gate that has neither distillation nor fusion, as stated. Accordingly, all those souls wither in the dust, which is the kelippot , and this is the mystical meaning of the verse: “The tears of the oppressed, who have no comforter” (Ecclesiastes 4:1). The kelippa of the dust rules over them with impudence and stubbornness, as she is confident in her strength, that there is no one who can save them from her hand. This is why Rabbi Ḥiyya wept, and said to the dust, which is the kelippot : **“How stubborn you are! How impudent! For everything that the eye covets will wither in you.”** All those highest of souls, which are **coveted by the eyes,** rot in you, without hope of deliverance from your hand.

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] proceeds: **“All the pillars of light in the world, you will consume and grind.”** That is, all the righteous of the world, who illuminate the world, are also deficient from [reaching] their completeness on account of the captivity of these lofty souls, since all the souls are incorporated in one another. Thus, these [righteous ones] are also consumed and ground through the strength of the impudence of this dust.

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] continues: **“The holy luminary** etc. **Rabbi Shimon is not withering in you”** He initially wanted to say that Rabbi Shimon is also withering in this dust, because he heard from Rabbi Yosei that he too agrees that this gate is sealed and may not be revealed. But he subsequently wondered and said, “**Rabbi Shimon, the light of the luminary,** etc. **and you exist and lead the world.”** In other words, since he sustains and leads all the worlds, how is it possible for him not to be whole in his full completeness?” After that, **“he was silent for a moment,”** i.e., he thought the matter over and stated decisively that **“Rabbi Shimon is not withering in you,”** since he is certainly in a state of complete wholeness, only that he could not comprehend how that could be.

**50. “Rabbi Ḥiyya arose etc.” Rabbi Ḥiyya arose and was walking and crying, and Rabbi Yosei with him. He fasted forty days from that day,** [in order] **to see Rabbi Shimon. He was informed: “You are unworthy of seeing him.” He wept and fasted forty more days. He was shown in a vision Rabbi Shimon and Rabbi Elazar, his son, engaged in this matter that Rabbi Yosei said in the name of Rabbi Shimon** (section 45, above)**, and several thousands were listening to his words.**

Explanation: In his distress for the beauty that withers in the dust, as described above, he yearned to see Rabbi Shimon’s level, because he had already decided that Rabbi Shimon is not withering in the dust. **“In this matter that Rabbi Yosei said,”** i.e., the above statement that Rabbi Yosei said to Rabbi Ḥiyya in the name of Rabbi Shimon, which led to this whole awakening.

**51. “In the meantime, he saw several etc.” In the meantime, he saw several large and lofty wings, and Rabbi Shimon and Rabbi Elazar his son climbed onto them, ascending to the academy of the firmament. All those wings were waiting for them. He saw that** Rabbi Shimon and Rabbi Elazar **returned and were renewed in their brightness and illuminated more than the light of the brightness of the sun.**

Explanation: **“The academy of the firmament”** means the seminary of **Metatron**, as stated in the Zohar that the higher academy is the academy of the Holy One, blessed be He, while the academy of the firmament is the seminary of Metatron (see Zohar Ḥadash , Yitro , 36a; in Zohar Ḥadash with the commentary of the Sulam , it is Yitro , 255).

[The Zohar ] continues: **“All those wings were waiting for them.”** “Wings” are the angels that help the souls, in raising them from one level to the next. Just as the soul requires the assistance of the wings for the ascension, [the soul] likewise needs their assistance to return to its place. This is the meaning of the statement here, that the **“wings were waiting for them,”** to bring them back.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“He saw that they returned and were renewed in their brightness** etc.**”** He saw them returning from the academy of the firmament to their place, i.e., to Rabbi Shimon’s academy, and they were renewed in the brightness of the light of their faces, and they illuminated more than the light of the sun.

**52. “Rabbi Shimon opened etc.” Rabbi Shimon opened** [his discourse] **and said: “Let Rabbi Ḥiyya enter and see how much the Holy One, blessed be He, will renew the faces of the righteous in the next world. Happy is he who comes here without shame, and happy is he who stands in that world like a pillar that is strong in everything.”** Rabbi Ḥiyya **saw himself entering, and Rabbi Elazar arose,** as did **the rest of the pillars of the world who were sitting there:** They arose before Rabbi Ḥiyya, **and** Rabbi Ḥiyya **was ashamed** and entered**. He lowered himself and sat at Rabbi Shimon’s feet.**

Explanation: Rabbi Shimon hinted to him: **“Happy is he who comes here without shame.”** He also saw **Rabbi Elazar and the rest of the pillars of the world, that they were without shame**. However, he himself was in a state of shame, because of [the issue of] that beauty that withers in the dust, and which he did not have the strength to overcome, as stated. He thus states: “He was ashamed and lowered himself etc.”

**53. “A voice sounded out etc.” A voice sounded out and declared: “Lower your eyes, do not raise your head, and do not stare.” He lowered his eyes and saw a light that was shining from afar. The voice returned as before and proclaimed: “Hidden and sealed lofty ones, the open-eyed, who roam through the entire world, look and see. Sleeping lower ones, whose light of the eyes is sealed in the sockets** of your eyes**, awaken.”**

**“The voice returned as before.”** That is, after he had obeyed by lowering his eyes and not raising his head, he merited to hear this declaration, through which he obtained all that he had sought, as explained below.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Hidden and sealed lofty ones, the open-eyed, who roam through the entire world, look and see. Sleeping lower ones, whose light of the eyes is sealed in your sockets, awaken.”** The declaration awakened those souls that had obeyed the words of Rabbi Shimon, both those who were there and those who were not there. There were two groups, as explained below.

That which [the Zohar ] stated: **“Hidden [and sealed] lofty ones... look and see. Sleeping lower ones,** etc. **awaken.”** The declaration went out to all the souls of the righteous and divided them into two groups: One group is the holy lofty ones, who are “hidden and sealed,” and who merited the opening of their eyes, and to roam the entire world. To them, [the declaration] called upon them to look and to see, i.e., to draw forth the supernal lights. This is [meant to be done] together with the second group, which is all those camps that go and are roaming after the Holy One, blessed be He, and from His Presence, and they depart from His Presence,. They are called **“sleeping lower ones, whose light of the eyes is sealed in your sockets,”** as they are asleep and the light of their eyes is sealed in the sockets of their eyes. He called upon these ones to awaken.

**54. “Which of you etc.” Which of you has transformed darkness into light, and the bitter tastes sweet to him, even before he comes here**, i.e., while he is still alive in this world. **Who among you awaits the light each day, which shines when the King visits the doe,** at which point the glory of the King **is magnified and He is called the King over all the kings of the world. One who does not await this each day** while he is still **in that world,** i.e., in this world, **has no portion here.**

Explanation: The declaration underscores for each group the main desired quality for each of them: Regarding the quality of the first class, he says: **“Which of you has transformed darkness into light, and the bitter tastes sweet to him?”** These are the souls of Atzilut . In Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , “God made one thing corresponding to the other” [Ecclesiastes 7:14] – darkness opposite light, and bitter opposite sweet. Consequently, in the Torah of Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , there [are categories of] kosher and disqualified, ritually impure and pure, forbidden and permitted, holy and secular. That is not the case in the Torah of Atzilut ; there, the entire Torah is the names of the Holy One, blessed be He, and there is nothing secular there, God forbid. There, [the words] Laban the Aramean are considered a holy name, as is Pharaoh. All the names, that are kelippot and impurity in Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya are only holy, sublime, names [in the world of Atzilut ]. Thus, these souls that have merited the light of Atzilut transform every darkness to light and every bitter into sweet.

With regard to the quality of the second group, he says: **“Who among you awaits the light each day, which shines when the King visits the doe,** etc. **One who does not await this each day in that world has no portion here.”** This is referring to those who seek after the Divine Presence that sits alone, and who always await for the Holy One, blessed be He, to raise the Divine Presence from the dust. But others, apart from them, have **“no portion here.”**

**55. “In the meantime, he saw several etc.” In the meantime, he saw many of the colleagues around all the upright pillars, and he saw that they were being raised to the academy of the firmament. Some were ascending while others were descending. Above them all, he saw the winged one**, who is Metatron, **approaching.**

Explanation: While the announcer was calling, [Rabbi Ḥiyya] saw several of the souls of the righteous that belonged to those two aforementioned groups, around **“all the upright pillars.”** These were the souls of the righteous who were already in **Rabbi Shimon’s academy**. He saw them ascending to the academy of the firmament. **“Some were ascending while others were descending,”** as the first group ascended and the second group descended. This is the meaning of the statement: “**“Some were ascending while others were descending,”** as this is how they help one another, in accordance with the call of the announcer, who said to the first group, **“look and see,”** while to the second group he said: **“Awaken.”**

[Rabbi Ḥiyya] saw that through the awakening of all these souls, that is, through the strength of both groups together, Metatron descended from this academy to Rabbi Shimon’s academy and swore the oath cited below. Thus [the Zohar ] states: **“Above them all he saw the winged one approaching, and he swore an oath”** [section 56, below], since **“above them all”** has the same meaning as “through the strength of them all.” The **“winged one”** is Metatron.

**56. “And he swore an oath etc.” And he**, the angel Metatron, **swore an oath, that he had heard behind the partition that the King recalls every day and remembers the doe lying in the dust. At that hour, He kicks 390 firmaments, and all are startled and frightened of Him. And** the King **sheds tears over this**, that the Divine Presence is in the dust**. And the tears, boiling like fire, fall into the great sea. By the power of those tears, that one appointee over the sea**, who is called Rahab, **stands and is sustained, and sanctifies the name of the holy King. He accepts upon himself to swallow all the waters of Bereshit and gather them within himself when all the nations will assemble against the holy nation and the waters will dry up and they will pass through dry land.**

Explanation: He swore an oath that the King recalls and remembers every day **“the doe lying in the dust,”** which is the holy Divine Presence. This is not referring to the entirety of the holy Divine Presence, as [Metatron] would not need to swear an oath over that, as that is clear to all. Rather, the reference is to Malkhut of Malkhut , which Rabbi Ḥiyya thought was captive among the kelippot and had been completely abandoned, and thus **“he wept, declaring: “Dust, dust** etc. **for everything that the eye covets will wither in you** etc.” [section 49]. For this reason, she is called **“a doe lying in the dust.”** Here this great secret was revealed to Rabbi Ḥiyya through Metatron, who came to the academy of Rabbi Shimon, that **“the King visits every day and remembers the doe lying in the dust,”** but in the manner that Metatron proceeds to explain to us.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“At that hour, He kicks 390 firmaments,** etc.” The fusion through collision of the supernal light on the partition is considered like the supernal light **kicking** the partition, that is, the supernal light kicks and wishes to permeate below the boundary of the partition. But the partition blocks it and rebuffs the supernal light. This rebuffing is the mystical meaning of the returning light that ascends from the partition, from below to above, and enclothes the supernal light. This matter has already been thoroughly clarified (in the Introduction to the Wisdom of the Kabbalah , p. 4, section 14; see there in detail).

The concept of the **“390 firmaments”** is that the partition is called a dividing firmament, and it incorporates four levels, which are Ḥokhma , Bina , Tiferet , and Malkhut , which are the four letters of Havaya [ heh-vav-yod-heh ]. Since the Malkhut was tempered by Bina , the partition has [aspects of] Bina , as stated, and the sefira of Bina is alluded to as hundreds, as is known. Thus, those four levels in the partition, of Ḥokhma , Bina , Tiferet , and Malkhut add up to four hundred. However, it was explained above that there is no fusion through collision on the [level of] Malkhut of the bottom heh , since [that level] is the mystical meaning of the sealed gate. Consequently, the one hundred of the sefira of Malkhut , which is the bottom heh , is considered to lack the ten of the Malkhut of Malkhut there, and it contains only the first nine, which add up to ninety. This is the allusion, that the partition which is called “firmament”, upon which the supernal light engages in a fusion through collision, which is a “kick,” there are not four hundred there, but rather 390, with ten missing, Malkhut of Malkhut . Therefore, the firmament is called “390 firmaments.” This is the meaning of the statement: **“He kicks 390 firmaments”** every day, at the time of the fusion through collision with the Divine Presence. This is to the exclusion of **“the doe lying in the dust,”** who is not involved in that fusion through collision, as she is the mystical meaning of the ten who are lacking from the four hundred.

**“And all are startled and frightened of Him.”** The mystical meaning of the impact of the partition upon the supernal light lies in the mystical meaning of "startling and fright, " that is, the fear that [the level] might receive more than its capacity.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“And** the King **sheds tears over this.”** The brains of the level of Ḥokhma are called eyes, since the five sefirot of the head are called gulgalta , eyes, and ears, nose, and mouth. Just as those drops that the eyes emit are called “tears,” so too these drops that the level of Ḥokhma emits are called “tears.” The meaning of this emission of tears is, as explained just earlier (third paragraph), with regard to the mystical meaning of the fusion through collision. The supernal light that is drawn to the lower [level] and hits the partition, kicks and strikes [the partition], that is, it wants to continue to below the boundary in the partition. However, the partition immediately prevails over [the supernal light] and rebuffs it, as [the partition] does not let [the supernal light] cross its border; see there.

However, in the meantime, that is, before the partition rebuffed [the supernal light], very small drops from the supernal light were necessarily drawn below the boundary of the partition, as for all the speed of the partition, it did not manage to rebuff them from itself upward. You should know that these drops cannot be incorporated in the height of Ḥokhma that emerged in the lower level, since they are without the enclothing of returning light, and they are emitted and exit the partzuf of Ḥokhma . These [emissions] are called “tears.”

This is the mystical meaning of the [phenomenon that] when a corporeal person is filled with compassion and love for his friend, he sheds tears from his eyes, as this is drawn from the aforementioned root of the spiritual tears. Anything spiritual that occurs in the higher [realms] impacts and creates a branch in the corporeal creatures, as is known. The fact that the supernal light kicks and strikes upon the partition, to breach its boundary, that is because the supernal light is constantly drawn from Ein Sof , blessed be He, which is above the world of constriction, where no boundary can be discerned, God forbid.

Since the supernal light yearns and longs to spread, in the manner that the Sages said: “The Holy One, blessed be He, yearned to dwell in the lower realms,” and likewise that the [dwelling of the] Divine Presence in the lower realms is a need of the Most High, [the supernal light] therefore kicks and strikes on the boundary of the partition, [trying] to be drawn below its boundary. The partition rebuffs [the supernal light] as returning light, and at the same time, tears are emitted, as stated. Thus, these tears are expressed due to compassion and love for the lower realm. Therefore, in the corporeal branch as well, tears are always emitted when a person is moved by love and compassion for his friend. However, spiritual tears do not disappear like corporeal ones, as explained below.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“And the tears, boiling like fire, fall into the great sea.”** This is the mystical meaning of the verse: “For love is strong as death, jealousy is cruel as the grave; its flashes are flashes of fire, a flame of the Lord” (Song of Songs 8:6). As explained, these tears are the result of the compassion and love of the supernal light toward the lower realm. Just as you find in the corporeal branch, [that] when a person is filled with love and compassion for his friend, the tears are boiling, in accordance with the measure of his feelings for him, the same applies to these tears – they are as scorching as fire, in the mystical meaning of “its flashes are flashes of fire, a flame of the Lord.” This is the meaning of **“tears, boiling like fire, fall into the great sea.”** The attribute of Malkhut from the frame of reference of Ḥokhma is called “the great sea,” since great waters are drawn from it, “mighty breakers of the sea” [Psalms 93:4].

[The Zohar ] continues: **“By the power of those tears, that one appointee over the sea stands and is sustained.”** This is referring to that ministering angel of the sea who was killed at the time of the creation of the world. This is as the Sages said ( Bava Batra 74b) on the verse: “And by His understanding He smites Rahab” [Job 26:12], that when he was instructed: “Let the waters be gathered together to one place” (Genesis 1:9), he did not want to swallow the waters of Bereshit . It [thus] states that he **“stands and is sustained”** on those tears that fall into **“the great sea,”** as he is revived through them.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“And he sanctifies the name of the holy King, and he accepts upon himself to swallow all the waters of Bereshit .”** At the time of the creation of the world, no rectification reached Malkhut of Malkhut , since the Emanator rectified the worlds of Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya with the mystical meaning of the feminine waters of Bina , not the feminine waters of Malkhut . This was enough only for the first nine [ sefirot ] of Malkhut , but not for Malkhut of Malkhut , as stated above.

This is the mystical meaning of the Sages’ comment on the verse: “You are My people” (Isaiah 51:16) – “you are My people in partnership; I started the worlds, and you finish them.” The entire rectification of Malkhut of Malkhut is solely the responsibility of the lower [beings]. Accordingly, when it was said to the ministering angel of the sea: “Let the waters be gathered together to one place,” he refused and did not want to swallow all the waters of Bereshit , because the kelippot would have overcome him due to the lack of rectification of Malkhut of Malkhut . For this reason he was killed. However, these aforementioned tears are the ones that purify and rectify the Malkhut of Malkhut , which is why they vitalize the ministering angel of the sea, so that he can stand and **sanctify the name of the holy King**, that is, to observe his Master’s command and **“swallow all the waters of Bereshit .”** Then all the kelippot in the world, and all the evil powers, will be nullified and they will all be gathered to one place, which is the mystical meaning of Atzilut . The world of Atzilut will expand, equal to the legs of Adam Kadmon , [reaching] until this world. This will be the completion of the rectification because Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya will return to being Atzilut . This is the meaning of: **“By the power of those tears, that one appointee over the sea**, who is called Rahab, **stands and is sustained, and sanctifies the name of the holy King, and he accepts upon himself to swallow all the waters of Bereshit .”**

[The Zohar ] continues: **“When all the nations will assemble against the holy nation.”** This will occur in the future, at the [time of the] completion of the rectification, when all the nations of the world will gather together to destroy Israel, God forbid. It will then be revealed that the ministering angel of the sea will swallow all **“the waters of Bereshit .”** The waters will dry up and the children of Israel will pass through [on] dry land [see Exodus 14:29]. This is the mystical meaning of [the verse]: as it is written, “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show him marvelous things” (Micah 7:15). However, that [in the past] was only the beginning, as that happened only in the Red Sea and only for a limited time. At [the time of] the completion of the rectification, by contrast, death will be swallowed up forever [see Isaiah 25:8].

Metatron thereby thoroughly clarified the oath he had taken, when he swore, **“that the King recalls every day and remembers the doe lying in the dust.”** Although the fusion through collision that He performs with His Divine Presence every day is only of the **“390 firmaments,”** that is, only in the first nine [ sefirot ] of Malkhut , and the [the final sefira of] Malkhut of Malkhut remains **“lying in the dust,”** such that it seems to us that the King does not remember it at all, that is not the case. Rather, He recalls it with each and every fusion through collision, since at each fusion tears are emitted, from the force of the kicking against the 390 firmaments. [These tears] do not perish, but rather they fall into **“the great sea,”** which is the mystical meaning of the aforementioned Malkhut of Malkhut , which gradually receives its rectification through those tears. [As explained, ] the ministering angel of the sea is revived by that measure [of tears], until the tears accumulate in sufficient amount to purify the entire Malkhut . This will occur when all the nations in the world will gather together simultaneously against Israel. At that time, the ministering angel of the sea will be revived and will swallow all **“the waters of Bereshit ,”** since the Malkhut of Malkhut will receive its rectification in its entirety. Thus, the King recalls **“the doe”** every day until she receives her rectification in its entirety. Here, all [the answers to] Rabbi Ḥiyya’s questions revealed to him, as he saw that nothing withers in the dust, God forbid. On the contrary, a fusion through collision is performed upon [the doe] each and every day, as Metatron swore to him.

**57. “In the meantime, he heard a voice etc.” At that time, he heard a voice saying, “Make space; make space, as the King Messiah is coming to the academy of Rabbi Shimon.” For all the righteous there are heads of academies, and those academies are known there. All these colleagues in each academy ascend from the academy here to the academy in the firmament, and the Messiah comes to all those academies and seals Torah from the mouths of the sages. At that time, the Messiah came** to Rabbi Shimon’s academy **crowned with high crowns from the heads of the academies.**

Explanation: Through this great revelation of the oath of Metatron, which is the revelation of the end, all those righteous who were at Rabbi Shimon’s academy ascended very high. [This ascent was] all the more so with regard to those two classes of righteous ones, as they caused the arrival of Metatron and his oath, through which they attained the most wondrous qualities, and they were all crowned and reached the level of **“heads of academies.”** In every academy there are members of the academy and above them there are heads of the academy. The difference between them is like the difference between the six extremities of a level and the first three [ sefirot ] of a level.

[The Zohar ] states: **“At that time, he heard a voice saying, make space; make space, as the King Messiah is coming.”** When Metatron revealed the mystical meaning of the end, a voice sounded and declared: “Make space; make space, as the King Messiah is coming,” because the concept of the end is connected to the King Messiah. [The Zohar ] gives a reason why all the righteous in Rabbi Shimon’s academy merited this – **“for all the righteous there are heads of academies.”** In order to merit welcoming the Messiah, one requires an equating of form with [the level of Messiah], and the mystical meaning of the King Messiah is the mystical meaning of the light of yeḥida , as is known. Therefore, had all the colleagues not merited to attain the status of **“heads of academies,”** [which is the light of yeḥida , ] they would not have merited welcoming the Messiah. This is the meaning of the statement: **“For all the righteous there are heads of academies.”**

[The Zohar ] continues: **“As those academies are known there... ascend from the academy here to the academy in the firmament.”** This is telling us not to think that **“the heads of academies”** is [the level of] the first three [ sefirot ] of lower levels. In response to such a claim, [the Zohar ] says: “**Those academies there** were at very high levels, very sublime, to the extent that all the colleagues in those academies merited to ascend from there **“to the academy in the firmament,”** and now all those colleagues merited the status of heads of these academies. Thus, [the Zohar ] says: **“As those academies are known there”** – they are known to have attained extremely high, lofty levels, until **“all these colleagues in each academy ascend from the academy here to the academy in the firmament,”** that is, all the colleagues from there merited to ascend from there **“to the academy in the firmament.”** What is more, **“the Messiah comes to all those academies and seals Torah from the mouths of the sages.”** This means to say that the quality of the colleagues of those academies is so lofty that the Messiah came to all those academies to be crowned with the innovations of Torah of the colleagues of the academy. And now all these colleagues of the academies merited the status of **“heads of academies,”** for those academies.

This is why [the Zohar ] concludes: **“At that time, the Messiah came crowned with high crowns from the heads of the academies.”** [Meaning, ] now, however, after all those colleagues of the academies merited the status of **“heads of academies,”** the Messiah is found to be **“crowned”** with the Torah of the **“heads of academies.”** He is thus crowned with the loftiest **“crowns from the heads of the academies.”**

**58. “At that time, all the colleagues arose etc.” At that time, all the colleagues arose, and Rabbi Shimon arose, and his light was ascending to the height of the firmament.** The Messiah **said to him: Rabbi, happy are you,** as **your Torah ascends in 370 lights, and each and every light spreads into 613 flavors, rising and immersing in the rivers of the pure persimmon. And the Holy One, blessed be He, is sealing the Torah from your academy and from the academy of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and out of the academy of Ahijah the Shilonite.**

Explanation: When the Messiah was revealed to them and came **to the academy of Rabbi Shimon**, all the colleagues arose, and Rabbi Shimon arose to that same level until **“his light was ascending to the height of the firmament.”** This indicates that Rabbi Shimon attained that light of the ten firmaments which are lacking due to the sealed gate of Malkhut of Malkhut . This is the meaning of the statement: **“And his light was ascending to the height of the firmament,”** which is the mystical meaning of the light of yeḥida .

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Your Torah ascends in 370 lights, and each and every light spreads into 613 flavors etc. of the pure persimmon.”** In other words, his Torah ascends to the Atik Yomin , in which each sefira reaches [a value] of one hundred thousand, and the four sefirot : Ḥokhma , Bina , Tiferet , and Malkhut are four hundred thousand within [ Atik Yomin ]. The [values of] units are in Nukba , the [values of] tens are in Ze’er Anpin , the [values of] hundreds are in Imma , the [values of] thousands are in Abba , the [values of] tens of thousands are in Arikh Anpin , and the hundreds of thousands in Atik .

However, according to this he should have said: Your Torah ascends in four hundred lights, and each light rises to one thousand flavors, which makes four hundred thousand. Instead, he only alluded to [the fact] that with respect to the lights that are from the Imma , the full four hundred is not used, but only 370, which is the mystical meaning of the verse: “He was the most honorable of the thirty, but did not attain to the first three” (see II Samuel 2:23). Even though **“his light was ascending to the height of the firmament,”** as stated above, [Rabbi Shimon] still did not attain the first three [ sefirot ] of the upper one hundred of the yod . Thus, he had only **370 lights**, without the thirty upper ones. The same applies to the thousands, which are the lights of Abba : [Rabbi Shimon] does not use the actual first three of each thousand, but only the six extremities of them each, which are six hundred. And instead of first three of each one thousand he uses thirteen, which are the aspect of Ḥokhma of the thirty-two paths (as stated above in Marot HaSulam , section 2, s. v. Ve’im zeh ; see there), as the mystical meaning of thirteen is Ḥokhma of the thirty-two paths, which is called **“the pure persimmon.”**

This is why he told him: **“Your Torah ascends in 370 lights, and each and every light spreads into 613 flavors, rising and immersing in the rivers of the pure persimmon.”** For the four hundred of Imma lack the thirty of the upper Ḥokhma , and [ Imma ] contains only 370. [Similarly], the upper four hundred are missing from each one thousand, those which are from the primordial Ḥokhma , and the thirteen **rivers of the pure persimmon** operate in their stead. [Thus, ] in each one thousand there are only **613**, because this is how they ascend, all the sealed, supernal secrets from the academy of Rabbi Shimon.

**“And the Holy One, blessed be He, is sealing the Torah from your academy** etc.” [The Zohar ] says above that the Messiah **“seals Torah from the mouths of the sages”** (section 57), as he is magnified and crowned by the Torah innovations of all the righteous. There is a well-known statement of the Sages ( Sanhedrin 99a) that “all the prophets prophesied only about the Messianic era, but with regard to the World-to-Come: ‘No eye has seen it, God, aside from You, (Who will do for those who await Him, ’ Isaiah 64:3).” Then all the levels that belong to the days of Messiah will be rectified, and all the secrets of Torah will be in the form of “no eye has seen it etc.” It will then be considered that **the Holy One, blessed be He, seals the Torah**. Since the Torah of those three heads of souls is from after the days of the Messiah, that is, an expression of “no eye has seen it...” the Messiah therefore said to him that **“the Holy One, blessed be He, is sealing the Torah from your academy and from the academy of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and out of the academy of Ahijah the Shilonite.”** These three were rewarded with the Torah secrets of “no eye has seen it, God, aside from You,” and **the Holy One, blessed be He,** Himself **is sealing the Torah** from their mouths.

**59. “And I came etc.” And I came to seal the Torah from your academy only because the winged one will come here, as I know that he will enter no other academy, but your academy. At that hour, Rabbi Shimon told him about that oath that the winged one had taken. The Messiah shuddered and raised his voice, and the firmaments shuddered, and the Great Sea shuddered, the leviathan shuddered, and the world was about to overturn. At that moment, he saw Rabbi Ḥiyya at Rabbi Shimon’s feet. He said: “Who admitted here a man dressed in a garment of that world**,” that is, in a body of this world**? Rabbi Shimon said: “It is Rabbi Ḥiyya, a light from the lamp of Torah.” He replied: “He and his sons will be gathered in,”** that is, they will pass away from this world, **“and they will become part of your academy.” Rabbi Shimon said: “Let time be given to him.” They gave him time.**

Explanation: The Messiah said to him that he had come **“to seal”** only because **“the winged one,”** came to his academy, [the one] who wants to know what he told him.
