It is one who enters the space of the circle and the square, the place where that point resides, and impairs it – he “shall surely be put to death.” And with regard to this, it is stated: “you shall fear.” Now, that point is called “I”** (Leviticus 19:30)**, upon which there resides that uppermost sealed one who was not revealed, which is Havaya , and** “I” and Havaya **are all one. Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Abba alighted** from their donkeys **and kissed him, saying: “But what is all that wisdom that is under your hand; and** [yet] **you are driving our donkeys behind us!” They said to him: “Who are you?” He replied: “Do not ask who I am; rather, I and you shall walk along and engage in Torah, and each shall say words of wisdom to light the path.”**

Explanation: **“From afar,” this is the uppermost point etc.”** This is the mystical meaning of the miftaḥa (key), from which the Ḥokhma of the thirty-two paths is bestowed (as stated in section 42, above; see there). It is the mystical meaning of the [letter] bet of Bereshit , which is called **“a point in His sanctuary,”** as from there [flows] the height of Ḥokhma for [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba when [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba ascend and enclothe Abba and Imma Ila’in . [It is] then that the two Shabbatot, the higher Shabbat and the lower Shabbat, are incorporated together, and with regard to them it is stated: **“From afar the Lord appeared to me,”** as the **[** Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba can receive [the light of Ḥokhma ] only with the enclothing of [the light of giving] (as stated below).

This is the meaning of the statement: **“‘From afar, ’ this is the uppermost point that stands in His sanctuary.”** The Ḥokhma and Bina , which are termed **“a point in His sanctuary,”** are called [“from afar”] because they are afar with respect to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , and must be enclothed in [the light of giving] of the lower world that is the mystical meaning of ** Ma ** that ends at the Nukba (as stated in section 16, above, s. v. Begin ). **“With regard to this, it is written ‘you shall keep, ’ it is included in ‘keep. ’”** Since [these higher sefirot ] require the lower fusion of ** Ma ** that ends at the Nukba , which is called **“keep [ shamor ],”** it follows that the height of Ḥokhma is also included in **“keep,”** and therefore **“You shall keep My Sabbaths”** is written in reference to [the inclusion of both the higher and lower Shabbatot]. [Thus, ] the higher Shabbat that is incorporated in [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba is included in the attribute of “keep.” [However, they are not both] in “remember,” since they necessarily end in the Nukba , in order to receive the height of [the light of giving], as explained. Only **the supernal king**, Ḥokhma and Bina by themselves, which receive Ḥokhma from “He who is near,” that is, without the enclothing of [the light of giving], are considered to end in “remember” and are called **“remember”** rather than **“keep.”**

**“‘And you shall fear My sanctuary’ is the point that is positioned in the middle.”** This is the aspect of the essence of manula (lock), which was established in Abba and Imma Ila’in , in the mystical meaning of “unknown air,” which is the mystical meaning of the middle point. This [point] operates only in Adam Kadmon , not in the world of Atzilut , and therefore there is no grasp [of this higher level] in the [level of] Abba and Imma Ila’in , who are the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina [of Atzilut ]. All the Ḥokhma that is bestowed in the world of Atzilut is only from the seven lower [ sefirot ] of Bina , which are called Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , as there the miftaḥa (key) operates, which is called **“a point in His sanctuary”** (as stated below). Since the manula (lock) was established in the Abba and Imma Ila’in , it is called “My sanctuary” (as stated in section 41, above, 3rd paragraph), and consequently fear rests upon [the manula (lock)] (see there). This is the meaning of the statement: **“‘And you shall fear My sanctuary’ is the point that is positioned in the middle.”**

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Who is he ‘who profanes it’ etc.”** As you already know, the **circle** is Abba and Imma (father and mother), and the **square** is [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that enclothe Abba and Imma and are incorporated **within the circle**. The Malkhut of [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] is the mystical meaning of the point within them. This Malkhut has two aspects, namely the ** manula ** and ** miftaḥa **. The miftaḥa (key) is called **“a point in His sanctuary,”** and is only the aspect of Yesod of [that] Malkhut , and it operates solely in Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . Manula (lock) is the [aspect of] Malkhut in Malkhut , which is the actual **middle point**, and it operates solely in [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] (as stated below). This is the meaning of the statement: **“It is one who enters the space of the circle and the square,”** that is, to the aspect of Malkhut of [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ], which is a **“space,”** as its air is unknown, **“to the place where that point resides,”** that is, to the place of the **“middle”** point, **“and impairs it,”** meaning that he wants to draw light into that **“space.”** He **“shall surely be put to death,”** as it is forbidden to draw any light into [that space]. **“And with regard to this, it is written ‘you shall fear, ’”** that is, the verse **“And you shall fear My sanctuary,”** which refers to **the middle point**.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Now, that point etc.”** The point itself is called **“I,”** Abba and Imma are ** Havaya that “resides” over** this **point**. This is why they are **“the uppermost sealed one that was not revealed,”** as they cannot be grasped by thought at all, and this is **“I, Havaya .” “And they are all one,”** that is, they are considered one, for this is why the point is also called Abba and Imma , that is, **“And you shall fear My sanctuary,”** as the point itself is regarded as holy, like the Abba and Imma, since they are one.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Abba alighted and kissed him.”** In order to continue explaining this section, I have to elucidate further this incident of the man who was driving the donkeys. Know that this **path on which Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Abba were walking** should not be understood literally. Rather, it is the mystical meaning of “the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, that shines more and more until the perfect day” (Proverbs 4:18). When it says that [Rabbi Elazar] was going to see **Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Shimon, son of Lakunya, his father-in-law** [section 74], this contains an allusion to the measure of their level at that time. For Ze’er Anpin has his own Abba and Imma , which are the Abba and Imma Ila’in . He also has his wife’s Abba and Imma , who are Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . First, Ze’er Anpin attains the Abba and Imma of his Nukba [female], who are Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , called the brains of neshama . Then [ Ze’er Anpin ] rises to a higher level and attains his own Abba and Imma , who are the Abba and Imma Ila’in , called the brains of ḥaya . Now, the righteous who traverse the levels are a chariot for Ze’er Anpin . Since that **path on which Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Abba were walking** was in the brains of neshama , the allusion is provided that Rabbi Elazar went to see his **father-in-law**, that is, the Abba and Imma of his Nukba [female], who is the brains of neshama .

The concept here is that one **who was driving their donkeys behind them** is the mystical meaning of the assistance to the souls of the righteous, which is sent to them from above in order to raise them from one level to the next. Were it not for this assistance, which the Holy One, blessed be He, sends to the righteous, they would be unable to emerge from their level and ascend higher. Therefore, the Holy One, blessed be He, sends to each and every righteous person a lofty soul from above, to each of them according to his worth and level, which assists him on his path. Now, at the outset the righteous person does not recognize that soul at all, and it seems to him that it is a very lowly soul that is accompanying him on his path. This is called “the gestation of the soul of the righteous,” that is, the soul from above has not yet completed its assistance, and therefore its identity is completely indiscernible. However, once [this soul] has completed its assistance and brought the righteous person to the desired level, he recognizes [this soul] and perceives its loftiness, and this is called “the revelation of the soul of the righteous.”

Now, this soul, which came to assist Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Abba, was the soul of Rabbi Hamnuna Saba. It is a very noble soul, immeasurably lofty, and it is the aspect of the light of yeḥida . However, at first [this soul] came to them in the form of gestation, and they only perceived the [soul] characterized as a donkey driver, meaning, an owner of donkeys. [This person’s] profession is to transport passengers on his donkeys from place to place, while he himself walks on foot before his donkeys, leading them. This is why he is called the “donkey [ ḥamrei ] driver,” as he leads the donkeys [ ḥamorim ]. The Sages state that “most donkey drivers [ ḥamorin ] are wicked” [ Kiddushin 82a], and this [profession] represents the lowliest form.

This is the meaning of Rabbi Abba’s statement: **“Let us open the doors of Torah, as now is the time and the hour to rectify ourselves in our ways”** [section 74], that is, to open the channels of the soul by opening the gates to the secrets of Torah, in order to be rectified on the path of the Holy One, blessed be He, on which they were walking. Rabbi Elazar interpreted the verse **“You shall keep My Sabbaths”** relative to the level in which he was positioned, that is, from [the perspective of] the brains of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is the mystical meaning of **“to see his father-in-law,”** as stated. [Rabbi Elazar] accordingly explained that the Shabbat itself is considered the aspect of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that are not of the aspect of holy, but which draw from the holy, that is, from the brains of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba draw forth on the day of Shabbat. Regarding these brains, they expounded the verse “And you shall fear My sanctuary,” as [referring to] the Ḥokhma that comes from the low brains of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba (as stated in section 7, above, s. v. Ve-zeh amaro ) for [these brains] are still poised for a question, and therefore there is an aspect of **fear** in that holiness.

Here, that one **who was driving their donkeys behind them** assisted them, and revealed the mystical meaning of the brains of ḥaya within them. He explained **“You shall keep My Sabbaths”** as referring to the higher Shabbat and the lower Shabbat that come together by means of the ascent of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba to the place of Abba and Imma , [where] the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba themselves become holy, in the mystical meaning of **a square within a circle**. With regard to them it was not stated **“fear,”** but only **“keep,”** since the brains of ḥaya rebuff all the external forces, and all judgments are removed on the day of Shabbat, and in this respect, there is no **fear** there. As for the verse “**And you shall fear My sanctuary,”** he interpreted it to them as referring to **the middle point**, which operates in the first three [ sefirot ] of Abba and Imma , that is, the first three [ sefirot ] of the brains of ḥaya , where [the intellect] has no grasp at all, and there, there is **fear**.

With that [explanation], the soul [of the donkey driver] completed its task, because it had brought them to the attainment of the brains of ḥaya , and then they merited the revelation of the soul of the righteous person, as they now recognized the value of that soul [of the donkey driver]. Therefore, **“Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Abba alighted and kissed him,”** since the attainment of a level is expressed as the act of kissing. However, in truth, the task of that soul had not yet been completed, because it still had to assist them in attaining the light of yeḥida , as stated here. Nevertheless, since the attainment of [the brains of] ḥaya alone is a whole level in and of itself, it is therefore considered that the soul was revealed to them in that measure [of ḥaya ]. This is the mystical meaning of why they now thought that [the donkey driver] was the **son of Rav Hamnuna Saba**, rather than Rav Hamnuna Saba himself. This is because Rav Hamnuna Saba [represents] the aspect of yeḥida , whereas his son is the aspect of ḥaya . Consequently, because they now attained only ḥaya , they therefore erred with regard to him, thinking that he was Rav Hamnuna Saba’s son. However, further along, after he informed them of the mystical meaning of the verse concerning Benayahu, son of Yehoyada, which is the revelation of the level of yeḥida , he was then revealed them in totality and they saw that he was **Rav Hamnuna Saba** himself.

[The Zohar ] continues: **He said to them, “do not ask who I am,”** as they themselves sensed that they had not yet recognized him completely (as stated just above), for the assisting task of that soul had not yet been completed. They therefore entreated him to reveal his name. However, he replied that they should not ask about his name because they were in need of further revelations of secrets of the Torah. In other words, the path was not yet fully rectified. This is the meaning of his statement to them: **“Rather, I and you shall walk along and engage in Torah,”** for you still need me to assist you in engaging in Torah. **“And each shall say words of wisdom to light the path,”** for we still need to illuminate the way because we have not yet reached our destination.

**86. “They said to him, who etc.” They said to him: “Who let you come here, to be a donkey driver?” He replied: “**The ** yod waged war against two letters, kaf and samekh , to come and connect with me.** The ** kaf did not wish to depart from her place and connect** with me**, because she cannot be for a moment other than within it**, the throne [ kise ] (as stated in section 31, above)**.** The ** samekh did not wish to leave her place because she must support [ lismokh ] those who are fallen** (as stated in section 28, above)**, for they cannot be without the samekh .**

**87. “The yod came to etc.”** The ** yod came to me by herself; kissed me, embraced me, wept with me, and said to me: “My son, what shall I do for you? But I am hereby departing, and I will be filled with several good things and concealed, supernal and precious letters,** and **then I will come to you and I will assist you. And I will give you the inheritance of two letters, which are loftier than the ones that have departed, and they are yod - shin , supernal yod and supernal shin , which will be for you treasures filled with everything. For this reason, my son, go and drive donkeys.” This is why I am walking in this manner.**

Explanation: As you already know, the mystical meaning of “driving donkeys” is the mystical meaning of the gestation of the soul of the righteous, who comes to assist one who is walking in the paths of God, to emerge from his level and arrive at a more important level, like those donkey drivers who assist people go from place to place on their donkeys. Now, at that [same] time, the righteous also falls from his previous level and reaches a state of gestation of a new level, like the soul aspect that comes to assist him. This state of gestation means a loss of brains. This is what they wanted to know from him: “How did the Holy One, blessed be He, arrange things so that you would come to us through gestation, for through this, we have experienced a loss of brains? This is the meaning of the question: **“Who let you come here, to be a donkey driver?”** [section 86].

[The Zohar ] continues: **“He replied, the yod waged war against two letters, kaf and samekh , to come and connect with me.” Yod ** is the mystical meaning of Ḥokhma , as is known. The level of the brains of neshama is called ** kes ** [“throne”], as in kese ha-kavod [“Throne of Glory”]. This is because the brains of Ḥokhma come enclothed and covered in [the brains of neshama ], and are not revealed. When the time came to attain the brains of ḥaya , which is ** yod ** of Havaya , the level with which I have come to reward you, in truth the Ḥokhma did want to connect to me the brains of ** kes ** as well. These are the brains of neshama that were previously in you, and **“ yod waged war”** against them. However, **“the kaf did not wish to depart from her place and connect, because she cannot be for a moment other than within it.”** The explanation [of this] is that the Malkhut of the upper [level], which is enclothed in the lower [level], is the mystical meaning of ** kaf ** (as stated in section 31 above, s. v. U-lefikhakh , see there). As explained there, when the kaf wished to descend from the throne, **“the throne shook, and all the worlds shook on the verge of falling.”** [This was] because all the connections of the levels with one another, from the top of Atzilut to the bottom of Asiya , occur through the higher Malkhut that is enclothed in the lower [ Malkhut ]. Therefore, [the kaf ] cannot descend from her place, that is, from the level of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is the height of neshama , even **“for a moment,”** as a break cannot be formed in the levels.

[The Zohar continues:] **“The samekh did not wish to leave her place because she must support [ lismokh ] those who are fallen, for they cannot be without the samekh .”** The mystical meaning of the ** samekh ** is the essence of the brains that the neshama receives from Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da’at , Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , of Abba and Imma , which are bestowed upon [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba in their phase of immaturity. [Those brains of the samekh ] support [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba of immaturity] so that they will not fall out from Atzilut (as stated in section 28, above, s. v. De’it ; see there). [The samekh ] must therefore remain permanently in her place, unchanged. The explanation of this is that the levels are fixed, and only the souls undergo changes when they transition from one level to another. Consequently, the brains of neshama did not wish to bond with the ** yod **, which is the level of Ḥokhma , and connect to the soul of **Rav Hamnuna Saba**, upon its descent to assist Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Abba. [This is] because these [brains] required a new [process] of construction and drawing forth of brains, following the usual order, beginning with gestation... until the height of ḥaya .

This is the meaning of the statement [here], in section 87: **“The yod came to me by herself etc.”** In other words, she came to me without the brains of Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da’at , Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , of Abba and Imma (father and mother), which is called ** samekh ** (as stated just above). As is known, the height of Ḥokhma cannot be enclothed without a height of [the light of giving], which is drawn from the ** samekh **, as stated. He thus states that since the ** yod ** came to me **by herself**, without the height of [the light of giving], she therefore **“kissed me, embraced me, wept with me, and said to me, my son, what shall I do for you?”** That is, [the yod ] **kissed** him and **embraced** him, because she wanted to be enclothed without [the light of giving], and she therefore wept with him and declared: **“My son, what shall I do for you,** as I have no scheme for enclothing in you.”

[The Zohar ] continues: **“But I am hereby departing, and I will be filled with several good things and concealed, etc.”** In other words, “I must therefore now depart, and you will enter into the mystical meaning of gestation, in order that you will be built by yourself with all the aspects of gestation, infancy and brains anew. Then I will return to you with whole brains, filled with everything.” Know that for the reason stated here, this applies to any new level, for whenever a person needs to receive a new level, he must undergo the departure of the previous brains and begin acquiring anew the aspect of nefesh that is called gestation, followed by infancy, which is the mystical meaning of the light of ruaḥ , as though he had never acquired any level before. This is why she said: **“For this reason, my son, go and drive donkeys,”** as it is impossible to extend anything from the previous level, and therefore you must start the gestation anew. This is called **“driving donkeys.”**

[The yod ] thus refers to **“the inheritance of two letters...”** which is the mystical meaning of the brains of ḥaya , called “the **inheritance** of the Abba and Imma .” They are likewise called ** yod - shin ** [ yesh ], as ** yod ** is Ḥokhma and ** shin ** is Bina , and these [brains] are certainly more important that those brains of neshama that departed. This is the mystical meaning of the verse: “That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance [ yesh ], and that I may fill their treasuries” (Proverbs 8:21), and it is the meaning of the statement **“which will be for you treasures filled with everything,”** that is, in the measure of the verse “and that I may fill their treasuries.”

**88. “Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Abba rejoiced etc.” Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Abba rejoiced and wept, saying, “Go, ride** the donkey**, and we will drive it behind you.”** That is, he should ride and they would lead the donkey. **He said to them: “Didn’t I tell you that it is the King’s order, until that donkey driver arrives?”** This is an allusion to the Messiah, regarding whom it is stated: “Lowly, and riding upon a donkey” (Zechariah 9:9). **They replied: “But you have not told us your name; where is your dwelling place?” He responded: “My dwelling place is good and of great value [ aiyla ] to me. It is one tower floating in the air, great and distinguished. Those who dwell in that tower are the Holy One, blessed be He, and one poor man. This is my dwelling place, but I was exiled from there, and I drive donkeys.” Rabbi Abba and Rabbi Elazar looked at him, and his words were delightful to them, as they were as sweet as manna and as honey. They said to him: “If you tell us your father’s name, we will kiss the dust of your feet.” He replied: “But why? It is not my way to pride myself in the Torah in that manner.”** The term aiyla has a similar meaning to its use in the phrase “when they divided it according to the value [ be’iluya ],” ( Kiddushin 42b).

Explanation: Now that they recognized his great merit, they could not bear his gestation on their behalf, and they therefore told him that now they had already attained the brains, it was enough for him and he could leave the [state of] gestation. If they still had something to complete, [they surmised, ] they could enter a state of gestation themselves, so why should he suffer on their behalf? This is the meaning of their statement: **“Go, ride, and we will drive it behind you.”**

**“Didn’t I tell you... until that donkey driver arrives?”** This refers back to his earlier comment to them, that they should not ask for his name because they needed further revelations of secrets of the Torah. Here he further alluded to them that his intent [in that comment] was to the aspect of yeḥida that they lacked, which is the mystical meaning of the welcoming of King Messiah (as stated in section 85, above, second to last paragraph). This is the allusion of **“until that donkey driver arrives,”** for the King Messiah is the mystical meaning of “lowly, and riding upon a donkey” (Zechariah 9:9). This is the meaning of **“that it is the King’s order, until that donkey driver arrives,”** because the King’s commandment is imposed upon him, to assist them until they merit the light of yeḥida .

They replied: **“But you have not told us your name etc.”** Since you have not informed us of your name, meaning that we have not yet attained from you what we need to attain, as stated, you can therefore at least inform us of **“your dwelling place,”** that is, your level, as we will thereby know what we lack which we have to attain from you. **“He responded, my dwelling place is good and of great value to me.”** That is, the place of my level is good and sublime compared to the level at which I am currently standing, since it is now beyond even my own attainment.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“One tower etc.”** This tower is the mystical meaning of the palace of the Messiah, and this is the meaning of the statement that **“those who dwell in it are the Holy One, blessed be He, and one poor man.”** The Messiah is the mystical meaning of “lowly, and riding upon a donkey.” [The donkey driver] calls it **“great and distinguished”** because a tower floating in the air, without further description, is Bina . Here, however, since it is referring to of the palace of the Messiah [and not Bina ], therefore he depicts it as **“one tower floating in the air, great and distinguished.”** [The driver] continues: **“This is my dwelling place, but I was exiled from there, and I drive donkeys.”** My place of residence is in the tower, but it is currently beyond me, as he stated earlier, that it is **“good and of great value to me”** because **“I was exiled from there, and I drive donkeys.”**

**89. “But my father’s etc.” “But my father’s dwelling place was in the great sea. He was a certain fish that circled the great sea from one end to the other. He was great and honorable, and so ancient of days that he would swallow all the other fish in the sea, and subsequently bring them out alive and well, filled with all the goodness of the world. With his power, he would swim the** entire **sea in a single moment. He took me out like an arrow in the hands of a mighty man, and he hid me in that place I mentioned to you,** that is, the tower floating in the air, **and he returned to his place and hid in that sea.”**

Explanation: The hidden fusion is called **“a certain fish,”** which is an allusion to the fiftieth gate. “The great sea” is Malkhut . Now, all the fusions from [ Atik Yomin ] of Atzilut downward do not include the whole of **“the great sea,”** that is, all the sefirot of Malkhut , but only the first nine [ sefirot ] of Malkhut , while the Malkhut of Malkhut is not included in the fusion (as stated in section 43, above, fourth paragraph) because it remains in the mystical meaning of “the path that no bird of prey knows” (Job 28:7). However, in the Atik Yomin there is a fusion upon that Malkhut as well, which will be revealed only at the completion of the rectification.

And Rav Hamnuna Saba emerged from that hidden fusion in the Atik Yomin , which is why he calls it **“my father.”** He states: **“My father’s dwelling place was in the great sea,”** meaning that [his father] engaged in a fusion with the Malkhut that is called “the great sea.” And should you say that all the partzufim engage in a fusion upon the Malkhut , [so what makes his father unique, ] to this he says: “**He was a certain fish that circled the great sea from one end to the other.”** That is, he is the aspect of a fusion upon the fiftieth gate, [because] he engages in a fusion with **the great sea** in all its aspects, from Keter to Malkhut , which is **“from one end to the other,”** including even the Malkhut of Malkhut . This is the meaning of: **“He was great and honorable, and so ancient of days,”** for he is called the Atik Yomin [“Ancient of Days”], and this great fusion does not [transpire] in reality from [ Atik Yomin ] and below.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“That he would swallow all the other fish in the sea.”** For this great fusion swallows within it all the fusions and souls in all the worlds, for they are all incorporated and nullified within it, like a candle before a torch. Relative to this incorporation, they are all called fish.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“And subsequently bring them out alive and well, filled with all the goodness of the world.”** In other words, after the great rectifications that follow that fusion, he once again gives birth to all the lights and souls he had swallowed during the fusion, and they live and exist forever, since they have already been filled **“with all the goodness of the world,”** as he swallowed them by means of his great fusion.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“he would swim etc.”** All the fusions from the Atik Yomin and below happen through the enclothing of the sefirot in one another, as these enclothings are considered as pauses along the process of the fusion, until the drop comes to the Yesod of male and female. This is not the case for the great fusion of the Atik Yomin – it is without any enclothing, and therefore the fusion is regarded as occurring **“in a single moment.”**

This is the meaning of the statement: **“He would sail the sea in a single moment,”** without any enclothing. This was performed **“with his power,”** as it was achieved through the many [aspects of] restraint incorporated in this fusion. He thus states: **“He took me out like an arrow in the hands of a mighty man”** – he gave birth to me like an arrow in the hands of a mighty man. However, there is no comparison between these powers and the powers that operate in the fusions below Atik Yomin . Rather, they are the mystical meaning of: “No eye has seen it, God, aside from You” (Isaiah 64:3), as stated below. Nevertheless, it is certainly the case that there is no birth without power, because a seed that is not shot like an arrow cannot fertilize ( Ḥagiga 15a). This is the meaning of the statement: **“He took me out like an arrow in the hands of a mighty man.”**

[The Zohar ] continues: **“And he hid me in that place I mentioned to you,”** that is, in the **tower floating in the air, great and distinguished, where the Holy One, blessed be He, and one poor man dwell**, as stated above [section 92]. **“And he returned to his place and hid in that sea,”** that is, after he had given birth to me and hidden me **in the great and distinguished tower,** he returned to his fusion and hid in his place, as before.

**90. “Rabbi Elazar examined etc.” Rabbi Elazar examined his words** [and] **said to him: “You are the son of the holy lamp; you are the son of Rav Hamnuna Saba the elder; you are the son of the lamp of the Torah, and you are driving our donkeys?” They wept together and kissed him, and departed. They returned and said to him: “Perhaps it will be acceptable to our lord to inform us of his name?”**

Explanation: They had not yet fully grasped his words, and their attainment was only of the brains of ḥaya . This is why they thought that he was **“the son of Rav Hamnuna Saba,”** since Rav Hamnuna Saba himself is of the aspect of the brains of yeḥida . **“To inform us of his name”** means to receive his level, because attaining his name means attaining his level, as stated.

**91. “He began and said: etc.” He began** his discourse **and said: “And Benaya the son of Yehoyada”** (II Samuel 23:20)**. This verse has been interpreted, and it is a fine** [explanation]**. However, this verse** [in fact] **comes to present the highest secrets of the Torah.** The name **Benayahu Ben Yehoyada comes to allude to the secret of the Ḥokhma . It** alludes to **a concealed matter, and the name is the cause. “The son of a valiant man” is the righteous one who lives for eternity. “Who had done mighty deeds”** means that he is **the master of all the deeds and all the supernal hosts, as they all emerge from him. He is** called **the Lord of hosts, as he is a sign in all His hosts; he is marked and greater than all.**

Explanation: The verse is here presenting and revealing supernal secrets of the Torah. **“Benayahu Ben Yehoyada comes to allude to the secret of the Ḥokhma ,”** since the holy name Yehoyada, [Yehoyada; “God knows”] means a knowledge that refers **to the secret of the Ḥokhma **. **“It is a concealed matter,”** a very hidden, sublime secret, **“and the name” Yehoyada** “is the cause” of its concealed status.

The meaning is as follows: The Keter of Atzilut is called “the head that is unknown,” and the Atik Yomin is the surrounding aspect of the five partzufim of Atzilut : Arikh Anpin ; Abba and Imma ; and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba . [ Atik Yomin ] is called the head that is unknown and does not make itself known. “Unknown” means that there is no fusion there, even in its own place. “Does not make itself known” means that there is no drawing forth of brains to the levels from it and below. Arikh Anpin of Atzilut is also hidden from the lower [levels], and therefore it is called **“the sealed Ḥokhma .”** However, it is not considered “unknown,” like “the unknown head,” since it has a fusion in its own place. Rather, it only “does not make itself known,” since there is no drawing forth of brains from it and below. All the brains made known in the worlds [below] during the six thousand years are only from [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ], and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which are called Ḥokhma of the thirty-two paths, or thirty-two [mentions of] Elohim in the act of creation.

This is the mystical meaning of the verse: “From where does wisdom come? And where is the place of understanding, seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living…God understands its way and He knows its place” (Job 28:20-23). It has been explained (in Adderet Ha’azinu , 72) [that] **“God understands its way”** [means] **its actual way, but “and He knows its place”** [means] **its actual place and all the more so its way, and all the more so that Ḥokhma which is sealed in it, in the holy Atik ;** see there. The intent [of these statements] is that “understands its way” is only the Ḥokhma of the thirty-two paths, which is the mystical meaning of the thirty-two [mentions of] Elohim in the act of creation. This is why it states “God [** Elohim **] understands its way.” The verse expresses Ḥokhma through a term of Bina , as it states **“understands [ hevin ] its way,”** because this Ḥokhma , in of itself, is only Bina , but it becomes Ḥokhma through the ascent [of Bina ] to the head of Arikh Anpin , as [ Bina ] receives from the sealed Ḥokhma and bestows to below. Accordingly, this Ḥokhma is revealed only through the path of Bina when [ Bina ] ascends to the sealed Ḥokhma of Arikh Anpin . The verse should thus be understood as follows: ** Elohim **, which is Bina , understands its path to the shefa of Ḥokhma . This is why it states **“its actual way,”** that is, [this Bina ] is merely considered a path to the shefa of Ḥokhma , but it itself is Bina , not Ḥokhma .

The mystical meaning of the verse: **“And He knows its place”** is that it is referring to Arikh Anpin . The name “He” represents that which is hidden and concealed from the lower levels, which is Arikh Anpin , who is called **“the holy Ancient One.”** He says about [ Arikh Anpin ] that he **“knows”** the **“place”** of the Ḥokhma of the thirty-two paths, since [ Arikh Anpin ] is the actual Ḥokhma that bestows upon the Bina . This is why the Zohar says **“its actual place, and all the more so its way,”** for since [ Arikh Anpin ] is the place [from where] this Ḥokhma is bestowed, [ Arikh Anpin ] certainly knows the way of Ḥokhma when it is enclothed in Bina . [The Zohar ] further states: **“And all the more so that Ḥokhma which is sealed in it, in the holy Ancient One.”** In other words, all the more so [ Arikh Anpin ] knows its own sealed Ḥokhma . However, this is also in the mystical meaning of **“and He knows its place,”** because this fusion is revealed only in [ Arikh Anpin ], in its actual place and nothing is bestowed from it and below at all. Thus, the brains of Arikh Anpin are classified as “knows” in its own place, but it is classified as “does not make itself known” from itself and below. Only the brains of Abba and Imma , which are the brains of the thirty-two paths of Ḥokhma , are regarded as “makes itself known,” in the mystical meaning of “God understands its way.” However, the upper head, above Arikh Anpin , which is the head of the Atik Yomin , is regarded as “unknown and does not make itself known,” for there is no fusion even in its own place, and there is no spreading of brains from it to the lower [levels].

Now, all this applies only to the souls and the worlds in general. However, with regard to the souls in particular, there are lofty souls that merited to be feminine waters for the great fusion of that head of the Atik Yomin after their demise, and to receive the level of yeḥida there in the upper world, [the level] which comes from that fusion. These are the souls of Benayahu Ben Yehoyada, Rav Hamnuna Saba, and others. Those lofty souls are revealed to the righteous in this world, and the righteous also merit to see the light of yeḥida that illuminates in those lofty souls.

This is the meaning of his statement that **“Benayahu Ben Yehoyada comes to allude to the secret of the Ḥokhma .”** This soul, called **Benayahu Ben Yehoyada**, comes from the inner [aspect] of Ḥokhma , the aforementioned Ḥokhma of the Atik Yomin . The illumination of that soul **“is a concealed matter, and the name is the cause,”** that is, the name **Yehoyada** causes the illumination of that soul to be concealed, for it means that ** Yeho ** [God] ** yada ** [knew], but it was not made known to others, and thus [this Ḥokhma ] remained hidden in its own place. Now, [the Zohar ] first clarifies the quality of the fusion and the loftiness of the height of the great light that emerges from that fusion of the head of the Atik Yomin . This is explained through the mystical meaning of the verse: **“The son of a living man, who had done many deeds, the God gatherer.”** He will subsequently clarify the meaning of the “concealed matter” with regard to the illumination of that soul, and this is explained by means of the phrase: “He smote the two altar-hearths of Moab,” until the end of the verse.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“The son of a living man etc.”** The meaning is as follows: You know that this fusion is the aspect of the fusion of the completion of the rectification and its mystical meaning is the fusion that incorporates all the fusions and levels that emerged one after the other during the six thousand years. All these lights gather in this [fusion] simultaneously. In the same manner, the feminine waters that ascend for that fusion incorporate within themselves all of the sufferings and the punishments that have been disclosed during the six thousand years, one after the other. Therefore, there is no end to the height of the level that emerges from this fusion, and it ends the kelippot and the Sitra Aḥara forever. The Yesod that bestows the masculine waters [from above to below] which incorporate all of the lights that emerged during the six thousand years, is called **“a living man, who had done many deeds,”** while the Malkhut that incorporates within itself all the feminine waters and the suffering that unfolded over the six thousand years is called **“the God gatherer.”**

[The Zohar ] continues: **“‘The son of a living man’ is the righteous one who lives in all worlds. ”** This name always refers to the Yesod , which bestows upon the Nukba . [This Yesod ] has no receptacle for its own needs, and it is therefore considered to be living only in the world, that is, in Nukba , when it bestows upon her. This is why [the Yesod ] is called “the righteous one who lives in all worlds.” However, in this fusion, [the Yesod ] is mentioned by the name **“one who had done many deeds,”** which means that he is **the master of all the deeds and all the supernal hosts.** For [this Yesod ] now includes in its masculine waters all of the good deeds and all the higher levels that were revealed one after another during the six thousand years. Now they are all gathered within [the Yesod ] simultaneously, and they are renewed in the supernal light, and emerge from [the Yesod ] to the Nukba all at once. This is why [the Yesod ] is called **“one who had done many deeds.”**

[The Zohar ] continues: **“As they all emerge from him”** at one time, to the Nukba . **“He is the Lord of hosts, as he is a sign in all His hosts; he is marked and greater than all.”** In other words, the holy name **the Lord of hosts** has now been revealed in [this Yesod ] in its lofty perfection, as [the Yesod ] is now **a sign** in all His hosts, in that it is marked with all the works and hosts. And it is **“greater than all”** – it is magnified, and transcends all of these in its illumination.

**92. “Who had done mighty deeds, etc.” “Who had done many deeds, the God gatherer”** (II Samuel 23:20)**. This great and precious tree, the greatest of all, from which place did it emerge; from which level did it come? The verse rejoins: “the God gatherer,” which is a lofty and concealed level, that “no eye has seen it,** [God, aside from You]**”** (Isaiah 64:3)**. It is a level that contains everything, and which collects within itself from the supernal light, and from which everything emerges.**

Explanation: Here, the Nukba is called by the name “the God gatherer,” for the reason that it **“had done many deeds, the God gatherer,”** that is, the Nukba gathers within itself all of the lights from the Yesod simultaneously and is therefore called **“who had done many deeds.”** [The Zohar ] further explains that the height that emerges [from] upon this [fusion through collision] is called **“the great and precious tree”;** [this height] emerges from the Yesod and comes to the Nukba . [The Zohar ] says that in order to show us the quality of that lofty height, from where it emerges and arrives, the verse uses the name **“the God gatherer,”** [meaning] that the supernal light gathers them in Yesod and bestows [these lights] upon the Nukba , and they are both called **“the God gatherer”** together.

This is **“a lofty and concealed level, that ‘no eye has seen’ etc.”** In other words, this level that emerges from that fusion is called **“no eye has seen it, God, aside from You.”** [The Zohar ] further states that the entire rectification is at that **level**, at the time of the final perfection. It is therefore considered **“a level that contains everything,”** because it **“collects within itself from the supernal light,”** all the goodness and the lofty lights from all six thousand years, all at once, and renews them with the supernal light. Consequently, it is this **“from which everything emerges,”** because the result is that all the desired perfection now emerges and is revealed.

**93. “This is the holy, concealed palace, etc.” This is the holy, concealed palace in which all of the levels are gathered and concealed. And all of the worlds are located in the body of that palace, and all the holy hosts are nourished from it and are perpetuated in their existence.**

Explanation: This is referring to the head of the Atik Yomin itself. [The Zohar ] says that it is a holy, concealed palace, in which all of the levels are gathered and concealed. [The Zohar ] thereby clarifies how this great fusion of the completion of the rectification was formed and made possible, such that it would incorporate within itself all the levels and heights that emerged one after the other during the six thousand years, and to renew [this fusion] and bring it out simultaneously, as stated.

[The Zohar ] thus states that this head of the Atik Yomin **“is the holy, concealed palace in which all of the levels are gathered and concealed,”** that is, throughout the period of the existence of the world, when the levels are in a state of ascent and descent. After a level is revealed, it once again departs, on account of the sins of the lower [beings]. Now, upon the departure of the level, it is not lost, God forbid, but ascends to the head of the [ Atik Yomin ] and becomes concealed there. In this manner, [ Atik Yomin ] steadily gathers within itself each level and height that is revealed in the worlds. [These levels] come there one after another, and gather and disappear within [ Atik Yomin ] until the time of the completion of the rectification, at which point [ Atik Yomin ] renews them and brings them out simultaneously.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“And** [all of the worlds are located] **in the body of that palace etc.”** For this **holy, concealed palace,** which is called the head of the Atik Yomin , is in the state of “unknown and does not make itself known,” throughout the entire duration of the six thousand years, as stated. Therefore, although it increasingly gathers within itself all the lights that are revealed in the worlds, no aspect of them is revealed until the completion of the rectification. Thus, after the concealment of each and every level, on account of the flaws in the lower beings – since [each level] has ascended to the head of the Atik and was hidden there – **all of the levels are gathered and concealed** in [that head]. However, the **body** of the Atik Yomin , that is, from the mouth of its head and below, is enclothed in the five partzufim of Atzilut , through which it illuminates to all the worlds. There is no illumination, small or great, which does not come from the body of the Atik Yomin .

[The Zohar ] continues: **“And all of the worlds are located in the body of that palace, and all the holy hosts.”** The body of the Atik Yomin is enclothed in all the partzufim that are in Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , and thus all the worlds enclothe it and exist upon it, as their entire existence and illumination come from it. **“All the holy hosts are nourished from it and thereby exist.”** This [includes] the lights that come to sustain the worlds, which are called “nourishments,” and it [includes] the lights that come for the brains of maturity. They are all drawn forth from the **body** of the Atik Yomin . It is with respect to the shefa for sustaining the worlds that [the Zohar ] says that they **“are nourished from it,”** while it is with regard to the brains of maturity that [the Zohar ] says **“and thereby exist,”** because [it is] the brains that establish each partzuf in accordance with the measure of height that is attributed to it.

**94. “He smote, etc.” “He smote the two altar-hearths of Moab.” Two temples existed and were nourished on its account, the First Temple and the Second Temple. Since it departed, the flow that had been drawn forth from above was withheld,** and it is considered **as though he struck them and ruined them and destroyed them.**

Explanation: After the illumination of the body of the Atik Yomin departed, the shefa that was drawn forth from it from above ceased, and therefore **two temples** were destroyed, and it was **“as though he struck them and ruined and destroyed them.”** This is a very deep concept. It implies that due to the revealing of the height of the great fusion of the head of the Atik Yomin , the illumination of the body of the Atik Yomin departed from all the worlds. Consequently, the temples were destroyed, and all the lights that had illuminated for Israel were darkened, as stated here. These are astounding ideas.

The meaning is as follows: All the rectifications apply only to the fourth level, which is called Malkhut and [also called] Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , or Ban ( bet-nun ) partzuf . The breaking of the vessels occurred on account [of the fourth level], as well as the sin of the Tree of Knowledge. All the work of the righteous during the six thousand years serves to return and rectify [the fourth level] back to its status before the breaking of the vessels and before the sin of Adam the first man. After [this rectification], the aforementioned great fusion of the head of the Atik Yomin will be revealed, which will uproot the kelippot and the Sitra Aḥara forever, in the mystical meaning of: “He will eliminate death forever etc.” (Isaiah 25:8). Since the Ban will have then already been rectified forever and will no longer require any rectifications, the Ban will return to be Sag ( samekh-gimmel ), and this will complete the entire rectification.

However, in the meantime, that is, after the great fusion of the Atik Yomin but before the return of the Ban to being Sag , there is the concept of the departure of the illumination of the body of the Atik , a departure that caused the two temple to be destroyed, that is, the two embodiments of the brains that illuminated in the two temples: The brains of Abba and Imma Ila’in , which illuminated in the First Temple, and the brains of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which illuminated in the Second Temple. All the illuminations of Israel were destroyed and departed, as stated here, and all those destructions are the final rectifications that restore the Ban to being Sag , which is all that is desired.

Then the two temples will be rebuilt at the hands of Heaven, through the aspect of the partition of the second level, which is Bina , that is, by means of the partition of Sag of Adam Kadmon [which is positioned] before the second constriction, and which is considered clean of any constriction. However, it will only be through the hands of Heaven, in the mystical meaning of: “Because He delights in mercy” (Micah 7:18). Then the two temples will exist forever, and the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun (Isaiah 30:26). [This means the light of the moon will be the light of] the higher Bina , which is currently the light of Ze’er Anpin , called the sun. “And the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, like the light of the seven days” (Isaiah 30:26), that is, like the seven lower [ sefirot ] of the Atik Yomin , from which the light is drawn to [ Abba and Imma Ila’in including Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] that emanated the seven days of creation. Ze’er Anpin , the sun, will once again be Ab ( ayin-bet ), which contains the light of the body of the Atik .

The reason for the departure of the body of the [ Atik Yomin ] before these rectifications is that there are no more than two Nukba s in the ten sefirot : Bina and Malkhut , called Sag and Ban . After the great fusion of the Atik Yomin , in which the aspect of Ban was nullified, the partition of Sag was nullified together with it. This occurred because of the rectification that took place in the body of the Atik , to partner Bina and Malkhut with each other, in the mystical meaning of the association of the attribute of judgment with the attribute of mercy (as stated in section 4, above, s. v. Adam ; see there). Through the force of this partnership, He emanated the partzuf of Arikh Anpin of Atzilut . All the partzufim of Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya emerged and were perpetuated only through this Malkhut that is partnered with and tempered by the attribute of mercy, Bina . Consequently, since the partition of Ban becomes nullified [at the great fusion of Atik Yomin ], the partition of the second level ( Bina ), which is the partition of Sag , has been nullified together with it, since they are bound together as one. And as the aspect of Nukba and the partition were nullified, the fusion with the supernal light ceased. Therefore, the entire illumination of the body of the Atik , [an illumination] which was through the partition that is associated with the attribute of mercy, departed completely. As a consequence, all the lights from it and downward, which are drawn from the body of the Atik , were destroyed.

This is the meaning of the statement: **“He smote the two altar-hearths of Moab. Two temples existed** [and were nourished] **on its account, etc. Since it departed, the flow that had been drawn forth from above was withheld.”** This is as was explained: Since the Ban was nullified on account of the great fusion of the Atik Yomin , the Sag was nullified together with it, that is, also the partition of the second level itself. As the partition is [then] unfit for a fusion, the supernal light ceased. This is [the meaning of the clause] **“the flow [ negido ] that had been drawn forth from above was withheld.”** Negido means the flow and spreading forth of the supernal light from above to below. It ceased on account of the nullification of the partition, as explained. Thus, due to the great fusion that occurred in the head of the Atik Yomin , the bestowal of light from the body of the Atik Yomin ceased and was nullified. The fusion of the head nullified the partition of Ban , and since until that point the partition of Ban had been joined with the partition of Sag in the body of the Atik Yomin as one, the partition of Sag was therefore nullified as well. And as there is [then] no partition for the fusion through collision, there is no room for the supernal light to bestow there, as is known.

**95. “The holy throne fell, etc.” The holy throne**, which is Malkhut , **fell, as it is stated: “I was among the exiles”** (Ezekiel 1:1)**,** that is, **that level which is called “I,”** Malkhut , **is among the exiles. Why? “By the river Chebar”** (Ezekiel 1:1)**,** meaning **by** the **river that extends and emerges** since past times [ kevar ], and now **its waters and springs have gone, and it no longer flows as before. This is as it is stated: “And the river shall be drained dry”** (Isaiah 19:5). **“Drained” in the First Temple and “dry” in the Second Temple. And for this reason it is stated: “He smote the two altar-hearths of Moab”** (II Samuel 23:20)**. Moab** means **that they are from the Father [ me-av ] in heaven. They were destroyed and are gone on its account, and all the lights that had illuminated for Israel have all darkened.**

Explanation: The **throne** indicates the tempering of the Malkhut in Bina , which is the mystical meaning of the Throne of Mercy, through which all the brains are bestowed in the [spiritual phase of] six thousand years to all the partzufim of Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya . This is the meaning of the statement: **“The holy throne fell,”** since due to the nullification of the partition of Ban , the partition of Sag , which is the mystical meaning of the **throne**, was also nullified and fell. **“As it is stated: ‘I was among the exiles, ’ that level which is called ‘I, ’ is among the exiles”** – “I” is the mystical meaning of Malkhut of the upper [level] which becomes Keter for the lower [level]. This is because the letters alef-nun-yod [ ani , “I”] are the same letters as ein [absence], which is the name of the Keter .

It is known that the Malkhut of an upper [level] is the entire connection between the partzufim . Each upper [level] performs the [fusion through collision] on its Malkhut , which draws forth returning light that enclothes the direct light of the upper [level]. Subsequently, the Malkhut of the upper [level] descends in the mystical meaning of the ten sefirot of the returning light, within which is the height of direct light, and [this structure] is enclothed in the lower [level]. This illustrates that now **“that level which is called ‘I’ is among the exiles,”** since the [fusion through collision] with the supernal light has been nullified from [that level as a result of the partition being nullified] and the supernal light has ceased from all the partzufim . This is the meaning of the statement: **“Why? ‘By the river Chebar” – by** the **river that extends and emerges; its waters and springs are gone.”** While [the level] is established with a partition, it is called “a river that extends and emerges,” that is, the supernal light is drawn by means of [the level] to the lower [level below], like the waters of a river that are drawn and flow unceasingly.

But now that the partition has been nullified, the river aspect [of the level] is called **“the river Chebar,”** for in the past [ kevar ] it was a river, but not currently, since now **“its waters and springs have gone.”** “Its waters” is the supernal light that was drawn forth from it; “its springs” means the partition, which was considered a spring while it was established in [the level]. [The level considered a spring] because the shefa was connected to it and ceaselessly flowed from it. Now all that has stopped **“and it no longer flows as before,”** as the supernal light is no longer drawn from it like previously, **“This is as it is stated: ‘And the river shall be drained dry’; ‘drained’ in the First Temple and ‘dry’ in the Second Temple.** The Imma is called **“the First Temple,”** while Tevuna is called **“the Second Temple.”** It says **“drained”** with regard to the First Temple because the fusion stopped in it, as the spring, which is the partition, was drained. And since there is no [fusion through collision] in the supernal Imma , Tevuna was therefore entirely dried out. This is why it says “dry” with respect to Tevuna .

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Moab, that they are from the Father [ me-av ] in heaven etc.”** For the root of the brains of the two temples is from the Abba , who is the Father in heaven, that is, the one who illuminates for Ze’er Anpin , which is called heaven, whose lights elevated [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba to [the level of] Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna in the Second Temple, and to [the level of] Abba and Imma Ila'in in the First Temple. They have now been destroyed and darkened **“on its account,”** that is, due to the cessation of the shefa of the body of the Atik Yomin , **“and all the lights that had illuminated for Israel have all darkened.”** In other words, not only have the great brains of the two temples darkened, but all the lights that shone for Israel, that is, even the lights of the six extremities and the lights of Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , have been destroyed.

**96. “Furthermore, ‘he also went down, etc.” Furthermore, “he also went down and slew a lion”** (II Samuel 23:20)**. In the early times, when this river extended its waters below, Israel were in a state of wholeness because they would sacrifice sacrifices and offerings to atone for their souls. Then an image of a lion would descend from above and they would see it on the altar crouching over its prey, eating the offerings like a mighty man. All of the dogs**, that is, the accusers, **would hide from it and would not come out** to accuse**.**

Explanation: The Sages said regarding the fire from above, which would hover over the altar in the Temple, that it would crouch like a **lion** ( Yoma 21b), as it would burn the offerings that the children of Israel offered upon it. This is the meaning of the statement: **“In the early times, when this river drew its waters below, Israel were in a state of wholeness.”** Before the illumination of the [ Atik Yomin ] was nullified, and when the supernal lights were drawn to Israel like a river whose waters extend from above to below ceaselessly, Israel were then in their full state of wholeness.

**“Because they would sacrifice sacrifices and offerings to atone for their souls.”** With the offerings that they would sacrifice, they would raise feminine waters for the supernal fusion on the partition, and masculine waters, which are the brains, would be drawn out. They thereby drew closer in great unification to their Father in heaven, and all the kelippot fled and distanced themselves from them. This is the mystical meaning of **“to atone for their souls,”** as the distancing of the kelippot from the souls is considered **atonement** [ le-khapara ]. This is like a garment that is stained and dirty with marks – by means of washing, we remove and cleanse [ mekhaprim ] all the stains from the garment.

This is why they are called “offerings [ korbanot ],” since they draw Israel near [ makrivin ] their Father in heaven. Since [the people of Israel] were in a state of wholeness and were raising feminine waters solely to bring satisfaction to their Maker, those feminine waters would ascend to Bina , where there is the light of giving and bestowal in the mystical meaning of a lion, which is a name for Ḥesed . [Through this process of raising feminine waters, ] the lion of Bina is considered to have received the good deeds and feminine waters that the children of Israel raised. The [people of Israel] saw how their feminine waters were [like] prey for this supernal Bina , and the light of giving of Bina was drawn forth in direct light over the feminine waters, and the direct light would hover over the prey, that is, the feminine waters, and consume it.

The meaning of the lion’s eating of the offering is that the essence of an offering is the feminine waters that ascend to strengthen the partition and to raise returning light, as stated. Since the amount of direct light is determined by the measure of the returning light that ascends from the partition, the direct light is considered to be nourished by the feminine waters, and [the direct light] increases and is sustained by [the feminine waters]. This is similar to an animal that is sustained and grows by the food it eats. Likewise, the whole vitality of a corporeal animal depends on the food it consumes, and upon the cessation [of this food, the animal] will die. In the same manner, the supernal light depends on the returning light that ascends from the partition. Upon the cessation of the returning light, [the direct light] is nullified from [manifesting in] the lower [level].

This is the meaning of the statement: **“An image of a lion would descend from above.”** That is, the light of Bina , which is drawn from above to below in the mystical meaning of direct light, is in the **image of a lion**, that is, the form of bestowal, like the nature of Bina . **“They would see it on the altar crouching over its prey” –** they saw the direct light enclothing and crouching within the returning light that ascends from the offering, which is its prey and nourishment, as stated.

**“Eating the offerings like a mighty man.”** It eats and grows from the offerings, like a mighty man. Since Israel was in a state of wholeness, the amount of bestowal, which is the raising of feminine waters and returning light, had great power from below upward. This is because the height of the returning light is determined by the size of the impact of the [direct light against the] partition, [measured by the amount] of startling and fright, [such that the partition accordingly] rebuffs the supernal light from below upward. And like the measure of the height of the ascent of returning light, so is the height of direct light that is drawn into [the returning light]. Therefore, if the height of returning light ascends with great power, it is considered that the **lion** is **“eating the offerings like a mighty man,”** in an upright form, with power, for it is through this power that [the lion's] height increases (all of this is described in my book, Introduction to the Wisdom of the Kabbalah , p. 4, section 14).

Thus [the Zohar ] says: **“All the dogs would hide from it and would not come out.”** The kelippa [deriving from] receiving for oneself is called “a dog,” as the Zohar states on the verse: “The horseleech has two daughters: ‘Give, give’ [ hav ; hav ]” (Proverbs 30:15), [which means] they howl like dogs, saying “give [ hav ] us the wealth of this world, and give [ hav ] us the wealth of the World to Come.” This is the strongest kelippa , and its grip is strongest opposite the light of yeḥida , in the mystical meaning of the verse: “Deliver my soul from the sword; my only one [ yeḥidati ] from the power of the dog” (Psalms 22:21). It is the corresponding opposite of the lion, **which eats** the aforementioned **offerings**.

Just as the lion, which is the mystical meaning of Ḥesed , is entirely [a state of] bestowal and no receiving at all – as the Sages said regarding the attribute of a pious individual [ ḥasid ], that “what is mine is yours and what is yours is yours” ( Avot 5:10) – the kelippa of the dog is all receiving and no bestowal at all. This is as stated about the righteous ones among the nations of the world, that all the kindness [ ḥesed ] they perform, they do for themselves (see Baba Batra 10b), since they are connected to the kelippa of the dog.

This is why [the Zohar ] states that when [the people of] Israel were in a state of wholeness and they merited the expression of a **lion that eats its offerings**, **“all the dogs would hide from it and would not come out,”** since [Israel] raised feminine waters with great power. They thereby gave power to the partition in Malkhut to rebuff the supernal light from it and above, with great power. As a result, the amount of returning light in the height was very high, in the mystical meaning of **“eating the offerings like a mighty man.”** Consequently, even those harsh kelippot , which are the dogs, all fled and hid, fearing that lion’s might, and they would not emerge from their hiding place.

**97. “When the sins caused, etc.” When the sins caused** [their downfall]**, he descended into the levels below and killed that lion. Since he did not want to give him his prey as before, it is regarded as though he had killed him.** Therefore, **he certainly slew the lion. “Into the pit”** (II Samuel 23:20) means **in** [front of] **the eyes of the Other Side, the evil one. Upon seeing this, that Other Side grew stronger and sent a dog to eat the offerings** from upon the altar instead of the lion**. And that lion, what is its name? Its name is Uriel, as its face is the face of a lion** [ aryeh ]**. And what is the name of that dog? Its name is Baladan,** as Baladan has the same letters as Bal-adam [“not human”] as the letter mem can be exchanged for a nun , **since he is not classified as a man but a dog and the face of a dog.**

Explanation: Since the aspects of partitions were nullified from Ban and Sag , Israel below could no longer raise feminine waters either, which is the nourishment of the lion (as explained in the previous passage). The fusion ceased and the supernal light, which is the aspect of the **lion**, departed. It is **“as though”** that **lion** were **killed**, for [this supernal light, which is the lion, ] ascended to its root above and disappeared from the lower [levels].

[The Zohar ] continues: **“‘Into the pit, ’ in the eyes of the Other Side, the evil one.”** For the root of receiving for oneself is in the eyes, in the mystical meaning of “the eye sees and the heart covets” (Rashi, end of Parashat Shelaḥ ). This aspect of receiving is called a **“pit”** because it is [an expression of]: "The pit was empty, there was no water in it” (Genesis 37:24), as the supernal light is not drawn there, in the mystical meaning of: “He and I cannot dwell in the same abode” (see Sota 5a).

[The Zohar ] continues: **“He slew the lion into the pit, in the eyes of the Other Side.”** For the slaying of the lion was in front of the evil eyes of the Sitra Aḥara , which is called a “pit,” referring to broken pits that cannot hold water [Jeremiah 2:13]. They have now come out of their hiding places and been revealed with great dominion. **“And sent a dog to eat the offerings,”** because the opposite of the lion **that eats the offerings** is the dog that is constantly howling hav hav [“give, give”], as stated.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“The name of that lion is Uriel, as its face is the face of a lion.”** The mystical meaning of the name El is Ḥesed , which is the mystical meaning of [the] right [side]. That lion, which is the light of Ḥesed , [the light of giving, ] as stated, is called Uri-El, that is, the **light** [ or ] that is drawn from the name El . His face is to the right, which is the mystical meaning of bestowal, in the mystical meaning of the verse: “And all four had the face of a lion on the right side” (Ezekiel 1:10).

[The Zohar ] continues: **“The name of that dog is Baladan, since he is not classified as a man but a dog.”** The Ze’er Anpin is called “a man [ adam ]” when it has brains from Bina , which is the mystical meaning of ** adam ** [ alef - dalet - mem ], which has a numerical value of forty-five [ Ma ]. The mystical meaning of Bina is bestowal, as stated. This is why the Sages said: “You are called ** adam ** but the nations of the world are not called adam ” ( Yevamot 61a), because all the kindness that they perform, they do for themselves (see Baba Batra 10b). This is why he is called **Baladan,** which is an anagram of ** Bal-adam ,** as a mem can be exchanged for a nun .

**98. “On the day of the snow, on the day, etc.” “On the day of the snow”** (II Samuel 23:20). That is, **on the day when the sins caused** [their downfall]**, when the judgment was issued above, from the supernal courthouse. It is therefore written: “She is not afraid of the snow for her household”** (Proverbs 31:21)**,** as **this is the supernal judgment, which is termed “snow.” Why** is she not afraid**? “For her entire household is clothed in scarlet”** (Proverbs 31:21)**, and** therefore **she could tolerate a strong fire. Until here is the secret of the verse.**

Explanation: The judgments that correspond to the male are called **“snow,”** and therefore they are considered to be drawn from the supernal courthouse. These judgments are very harsh at first, but slight in the end, as they are mitigated only at the conclusion, which is the Nukba . With respect to those judgments, the Nukba said: “Stay me with dainties [ ashishot ]” (Song of Songs 2:5), alluding to two ishot [“fires”], the upper fire, which is Bina , and her own fire.

Subsequently, once [the Nukba ] has those two fires, she mitigates the cold judgments of the **snow**, since her fire alleviates their chill. This is the meaning of the statement: **“‘She is not afraid of the snow for her household, ’ this is the supernal judgment,”** referring to the harsh judgments of the masculine, which is called the supernal judgment. **“Why? ‘For her entire household is clothed in scarlet [ shanim ]’” –** two [ shenayim ], which is the mystical meaning of those two fires. Since her household is clothed in two fires, **“she is not afraid of the snow for her household.”** On the contrary, the snow is tempered in her fires.

[The Zohar ] thus states that **“she could tolerate a strong fire,”** as this snow helps her bear her fires. This is informing us that now that the partitions and fusions of Ban and Sag have been nullified, and those two fires have [likewise] been nullified, the judgments of snow have regained their strength. **“Until here is the secret of the verse. What is written after it...** [from the start of the next section].” This is alluding to the fact that what has been presented thus far was revealed immediately after the fusion of the Atik Yomin , but what appears in the next verse is a consequence and comes afterwards.

**99. “What is written after it, etc.” What is written after it? “And he slew an Egyptian, a man of appearance”** (II Samuel 23:21)**. Here the secret of the verse comes to inform** [us] **that each time Israel sinned He departed and withheld all the goodness from them and all the lights that had illuminated for them. “He slew an Egyptian” is light,** that is, **that light which was illuminating for Israel. And who is “he”?** He is **Moses, as it is written** about him**: “And they said, ‘an Egyptian delivered us etc. ’”** (Exodus 2:19), as **he was born there,** in Egypt, **and raised there, and there he ascended to the supernal light.**

Explanation: The verse is not referring to an actual **man**, but to **light**, since He nullified and concealed the light, and this is considered as though He killed it. This is why it states: **“That light which was illuminating for Israel, and who is he? Moses.”** In other words, He nullified the great light of the illumination of **Moses** to Israel. He calls him **“an Egyptian”** because he was born and raised in Egypt, as it is stated: “Moses grew up and he went out to his brothers etc.” (Exodus 2:11). There he merited the supernal light, [and] the redemption of Israel from Egypt.

**100. “A man of appearance, this is as it says etc.” “A man of appearance”** (II Samuel 23:21)**, this is as it says: “Through appearances, not riddles”** (Numbers 12:8)**. “A man,” as it says: “The man of God”** (Deuteronomy 33:1)**, the husband, as it were, of that appearance of the glory of God,** which is Malkhut **, as he merited to guide this level on earth in all that he wished, which no other man has merited.**

Explanation: The difference between Moses and all the other prophets is that Moses was a chariot for Ze’er Anpin . He would construct and bestow from Ze’er Anpin to the Nukba , whereas all the other prophets were a chariot for the Nukba and received their shefa from the Nukba . This is why it states: **“The man of God, the husband, as it were, of that appearance,”** which is the Nukba , called **“the glory of God.”** Why is he considered the husband of the Divine Presence? It is because **“he merited to guide this level,”** as [Moses] was a chariot for Ze’er Anpin , and he would construct, bestow [upon] and guide this level, which is the Nukba . **“Which no other man has merited,”** as all the other prophets were a chariot for the Nukba , and the Nukba bestowed upon them. They are therefore located below her, and are guided by her, and thus no other person in the world merited the attribute of Moses.

**101. “And the Egyptian had a spear in his hand etc.” “And the Egyptian had a spear in his hand”** (II Samuel 23:21)**. This is the staff of God, which was entrusted in his hand, as it says: “With the staff of God in my hand”** (Exodus 17:9)**. This is the staff that was created at twilight on the eve of Shabbat, and a holy carving is engraved upon it, the holy name. With that** staff**, he sinned with the rock, as it says: “And struck the rock with his staff twice”** (Numbers 20:11)**. The Holy One, blessed be He, said to him: “Moses, I did not give you My staff for this; by your life, it will no longer be in your hand from now onwards.”**

Explanation: Twilight is the mystical meaning of the great tempering of Malkhut in Bina , until it cannot be discerned whether it is Malkhut or Bina . On Shabbat, Malkhut rises to Abba and Imma and becomes Bina . **“At twilight on the eve of Shabbat”** [ Malkhut ] is not yet actual Bina , but is not discerned as Malkhut either. This is the mystical meaning of the ten items that were created at twilight, as at that time their origin is undiscernible as to whether it is from Bina or Malkhut , since [at that twilight phase] the Nukba itself cannot be discerned.

This is the mystical meaning of the staff that was created at twilight, and for this reason **“a holy carving is engraved upon it,”** an engraving of **“the holy name,”** which represents the aspect of Bina , from which the holiness is drawn. The **“holy carving”** represents Malkhut , which is only an engraving for receiving **“the holy name.”** These two carvings were incorporated in the staff as a single, indistinguishable aspect, as stated, since [the staff] was created **“at twilight on the eve of Shabbat.”** Therefore, it had the power to draw forth all the lights and all the miracles and wonders for Israel, who are the mystical meaning of the drawing forth of the lights of Bina into Malkhut . Through [the staff], Moses merited the supernal Bina and the aspect of man of God, in the mystical meaning of “Moses the bride.” It is called **“the staff of Elohim ”** in reference to Bina , and it is termed “a spear” in the mystical meaning of the vav of Havaya , which fuses with the lower heh .

Now, the Malkhut [alone] is called ** tzor ** [“boulder”], while [the Malkhut merged within] the mystical meaning of Bina is called ** sela ** [“rock”]. The inner fusion of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , when they ascend to Abba and Imma and the Nukba uses the garments of the Imma (as stated in section 17, above), that fusion through collision is called “speech.” The external fusion of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , that is, in their own place, is called fusion through collision [ haka’ah ]. This is the mystical meaning of the statement to Moses in Parashat Beshallaḥ (Exodus 17:6): **“And you shall strike [ ve’hikita ] the tzor ,** and water shall come out of it...” since the ** tzor ** is the mystical meaning of Malkhut , in which striking [ haka’ah ] occurs. However, in Parashat Ḥukkat (Numbers 20:8) it states: **“And you shall speak to the sela ...**” since the sela is when [ Malkhut ] is in the place of Bina , and thus, the fusion is called “speech.” This is the mystical meaning of the sin of Moses, as he used his staff **twice,** for in addition to striking the tzor with it, he also struck the ** sela **, and that is the meaning of **“twice”** (Numbers 20:11). He thus **“sinned with the rock [ sela ],”** since striking does not apply to it, but only **speech** (as stated in the Zohar , Tetze , 76).

This is the meaning of the statement: **“With that, he sinned with the rock.”** Since there was no distinguishable mark on the staff of God determining whether it belonged to Malkhut or Bina , as stated, [Moses] ended up using it for the sela as well. **“As it says, ‘and struck the rock with his staff twice, ’”** that is, **upon the tzor and the sela ,** as stated. **“The Holy One, blessed be He, said to him: “Moses, I did not give you My staff for this” –** I did not give you My staff for you to use it for the aspect of sela as well.

**102. “Immediately, ‘he went down to etc.” Immediately, “he went down to him with a staff,”** that is, **with harsh judgment, “and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand,”** that is, **from that time,** the staff, which is the spear, **was withheld from him and he will not have it forever. “And slew him with his own spear”** (II Samuel 23:21) **– on account of that sin that he struck the rock with that staff, he died and did not enter the holy land, and this light was withheld from Israel.**

Explanation: In order to understand this, everything that was explained above (section 94, second to last paragraph) must be recalled. Due to the great fusion of the Atik Yomin , it was only necessary to nullify the Ban alone, not the Sag at all, and then the Bon would rise straightaway and become Sag for all eternity. However, since the Sag and the Ban were attached together, the Sag was nullified along with the Ban , and as a result the temples were destroyed in the meantime. For the same reason, the illumination of Moses to the children of Israel was nullified as well, for he greatly sinned with regard to the connection of the Ban with the Sag , by striking the rock, as stated.

Therefore, **“‘he went down to him with a staff, ’ with harsh judgment,”** as the nullification of the Sag was achieved through harsh judgment, since in fact he had no connection at all with the Ban , and the nullification of the Ban did not concern him whatsoever. This is the mystical meaning of the verse: “It seemed as when men wield upwards axes in a thicket of trees, and now all its carved work together they strike down with hatchet and hammers” (Psalms 74:5-6). On account of the raising and mitigation of the Malkhut and her ascent to the Bina , it is now like one who wields axes upward in a thicket of trees, since the Sag has also been nullified by this ascent, “struck down with hatchet and hammers.”

This is the meaning of the statement: **“‘And plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand’ – from that time it was withheld from him and he will not have it forever.”** The spear actually belonged to Ban , as stated. Consequently, this illumination was nullified forever, since the Ban itself was subsequently renewed and became Sag **for all eternity**, and therefore there is no longer any purpose in using the staff for striking.
